ko.title: [물류 101 #14] 98% 함정: "거의 정시"가 실제 돈을 잃게 하는 이유

segments.src: > A supply chain you can't measure is one you can't defend — this lesson covers the KPIs that matter, the SCOR framework that organizes them, how to price risk before it hits, and why emissions are becoming a logistics metric too.
segments.tr: > 측정할 수 없는 공급망은 방어할 수 없는 공급망입니다 — 이 강의는 중요한 KPI, 이를 체계화하는 SCOR 프레임워크, 위험이 닥치기 전에 가격을 매기는 방법, 그리고 배출량이 물류 지표가 되고 있는 이유를 다룹니다.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 오늘의 개념

segments.src: Every warehouse manager will tell you things are "running fine."
segments.tr: 모든 창고 관리자는 상황이 "잘 돌아가고 있다"고 말할 것입니다.

segments.src: The job of performance measurement is to replace that sentence with a number.
segments.tr: 성과 측정의 역할은 그 문장을 숫자로 바꾸는 것입니다.

segments.src: **Start with KPIs — but the right ones.** The single most useful logistics metric is the **perfect order rate**: the share of orders delivered on time, complete, undamaged, and with correct paperwork.
segments.tr: **KPI부터 시작하되, 올바른 KPI를 고르세요.** 물류에서 가장 유용한 단일 지표는 **완전 주문 비율(perfect order rate)**입니다. 정시에, 완전하게, 손상 없이, 서류까지 정확하게 배송된 주문의 비율이죠.

segments.src: It's brutal because it multiplies:
segments.tr: 이 지표가 가혹한 이유는 곱셈으로 계산되기 때문입니다:

segments.src: Perfect order rate = on-time % x complete % x damage-free % x correct-docs %
segments.tr: Perfect order rate = on-time % x complete % x damage-free % x correct-docs %

segments.src: Four "excellent" 98% scores produce a 92% perfect order rate.
segments.tr: 네 개의 "우수한" 98% 점수가 있어도 완전 주문 비율은 92%가 됩니다.

segments.src: Eight orders in every hundred go wrong somewhere.
segments.tr: 100건 중 여덟 건의 주문이 어딘가에서 잘못됩니다.

segments.src: That gap between component metrics and end-to-end metrics is where most supply chain complaints live.
segments.tr: 구성 지표와 종단 간(end-to-end) 지표 사이의 이 차이에서 대부분의 공급망 불만이 생겨납니다.

segments.src: Other core measures:
segments.tr: 그 밖의 핵심 지표:

segments.src: - **Order fulfillment cycle time** — order placed to customer receipt.
segments.tr: - **주문 처리 사이클 타임(order fulfillment cycle time)** — 주문 접수부터 고객 수령까지.

segments.src: - **Cash-to-cash cycle time** — days between paying your supplier and getting paid by your customer: `inventory days + receivable days - payable days`.
segments.tr: - **현금 전환 사이클(cash-to-cash cycle time)** — 공급업체에 대금을 지급한 시점부터 고객으로부터 대금을 받을 때까지의 일수: `재고일수 + 매출채권일수 - 매입채무일수`.

segments.src: - **Inventory turns** and **days of supply** — how hard your working capital is working.
segments.tr: - **재고 회전율(inventory turns)**과 **공급 일수(days of supply)** — 운전자본이 얼마나 열심히 일하고 있는지.

segments.src: - **Cost to serve** — total logistics cost per order, per unit, or per customer.
segments.tr: - **서비스 비용(cost to serve)** — 주문당, 단위당, 또는 고객당 총 물류 비용.

segments.src: **SCOR gives these a home.** The Supply Chain Operations Reference model, maintained by ASCM, is the industry's standard vocabulary.
segments.tr: **SCOR이 이 지표들의 자리를 마련해 줍니다.** ASCM이 관리하는 공급망 운영 참조 모델(SCOR, Supply Chain Operations Reference)은 업계 표준 용어 체계입니다.

segments.src: Classic SCOR organizes a supply chain into six process areas — Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, Return, and Enable — and scores them on five attributes: reliability, responsiveness, agility, cost, and asset management efficiency.
segments.tr: 고전적인 SCOR은 공급망을 여섯 개의 프로세스 영역(계획(Plan), 조달(Source), 생산(Make), 배송(Deliver), 반품(Return), 지원(Enable))으로 구성하고, 신뢰성, 대응성, 민첩성, 비용, 자산 관리 효율성이라는 다섯 가지 속성으로 점수를 매깁니다.

segments.src: The current digital revision (SCOR DS) renames and regroups those processes and folds in environmental and social measures alongside the economic ones.
segments.tr: 현재의 디지털 개정판(SCOR DS)은 이 프로세스들의 이름을 바꾸고 재편하며, 경제적 지표와 함께 환경 및 사회적 지표도 포함합니다.

segments.src: The details shift between versions; the useful idea doesn't.
segments.tr: 세부 내용은 버전마다 달라지지만, 유용한 아이디어는 그대로입니다.

segments.src: SCOR forces you to say *which attribute* you're optimizing, because you cannot maximize all five.
segments.tr: SCOR은 다섯 가지를 모두 극대화할 수 없기 때문에 *어떤 속성을* 최적화하는지 명시하도록 강제합니다.

segments.src: Faster response usually costs more.
segments.tr: 빠른 대응은 보통 더 많은 비용이 듭니다.

segments.src: Lower cost usually means less agility.
segments.tr: 비용을 낮추면 보통 민첩성이 줄어듭니다.

segments.src: Pick, then measure.
segments.tr: 선택하고, 그다음 측정하세요.

segments.src: **Risk management is measurement pointed at the future.** The standard move is a risk register: list what could break, score each item on **likelihood** and **impact**, and multiply to rank.
segments.tr: **위험 관리는 미래를 향한 측정입니다.** 표준적인 방법은 위험 등록부(risk register)입니다. 무엇이 깨질 수 있는지 나열하고, 각 항목을 **발생 가능성(likelihood)**과 **영향(impact)**으로 점수화한 뒤 곱해서 순위를 매깁니다.

segments.src: But logistics risk has a twist — the worst events are the low-probability ones, so probability estimates are close to worthless.
segments.tr: 하지만 물류 위험에는 반전이 있습니다. 가장 심각한 사건은 발생 확률이 낮은 것들이라서, 확률 추정치는 거의 쓸모가 없습니다.

segments.src: A more practical pair of questions, popularized by MIT's David Simchi-Levi:
segments.tr: MIT의 David Simchi-Levi가 대중화한 더 실용적인 두 가지 질문이 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Time to Recover (TTR):** if this node goes dark, how long until supply is restored?
segments.tr: - **복구 시간(Time to Recover, TTR):** 이 노드가 멈추면 공급이 복구되기까지 얼마나 걸리는가?

segments.src: - **Time to Survive (TTS):** how long can we keep serving customers on inventory and alternatives?
segments.tr: - **생존 시간(Time to Survive, TTS):** 현재 재고와 대체 수단으로 고객에게 계속 서비스할 수 있는 기간은 얼마인가?

segments.src: If TTR exceeds TTS, you have a real exposure, whatever the probability.
segments.tr: TTR이 TTS를 초과하면, 확률과 관계없이 실제 노출(exposure)이 있는 것입니다.

segments.src: The fixes are familiar: dual sourcing, safety stock at the right node, qualified backup carriers, postponement (finish the product late, closer to demand), and visibility into tier-2 and tier-3 suppliers — because the plant that shuts down is usually one your buyer has never heard of.
segments.tr: 해결책은 익숙합니다: 이중 조달, 적절한 노드에 안전 재고 배치, 검증된 예비 운송사 확보, 지연 전략(postponement — 제품 마무리를 수요에 더 가까운 시점까지 미루기), 그리고 2차·3차 공급업체에 대한 가시성 확보입니다. 공장이 멈추는 곳은 대개 구매 담당자가 들어본 적 없는 곳이기 때문입니다.

segments.src: **Sustainability is now a logistics KPI, not a press release.** Transportation and purchased goods sit in **Scope 3** emissions, which for most retailers and manufacturers dwarf their own facilities and fleet.
segments.tr: **지속가능성은 이제 보도자료가 아닌 물류 KPI입니다.** 운송과 구매 물품은 **Scope 3** 배출에 해당하며, 대부분의 소매업체와 제조업체에서 이는 자체 시설과 차량 배출량을 압도합니다.

segments.src: The operational levers are the same ones that cut cost: raise trailer load factor, cut **empty miles**, shift long hauls from truck to intermodal rail, right-size packaging, consolidate LTL shipments into full truckloads.
segments.tr: 운영상의 수단은 비용을 줄이는 것과 같습니다: 트레일러 적재율 높이기, **공차 운행(empty miles)** 줄이기, 장거리 운송을 트럭에서 복합운송 철도(intermodal rail)로 전환하기, 포장 크기 적정화, LTL 화물을 만재(FTL) 트럭으로 통합하기.

segments.src: Emissions per ton-mile is the metric; the EPA's SmartWay program is the common US benchmark for carrier performance.
segments.tr: 지표는 톤-마일당 배출량이며, 미국 EPA의 SmartWay 프로그램이 운송사 성과의 일반적인 미국 벤치마크입니다.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 일상 속에서

segments.src: Say you run a Columbus, Ohio distributor selling houseware to a big-box retailer.
segments.tr: 오하이오주 컬럼버스에서 대형 소매 체인에 생활용품을 판매하는 유통업체를 운영한다고 해봅시다.

segments.src: Your goods move from a supplier in Vietnam, through the Port of Long Beach, by rail to Chicago, then by truck to your DC.
segments.tr: 상품은 베트남 공급업체에서 출발해 롱비치항을 거쳐, 철도로 시카고까지 이동한 뒤, 트럭으로 물류센터(DC)에 도착합니다.

segments.src: Your internal dashboard looks great: 97% on-time from the DC, 99% pick accuracy.
segments.tr: 내부 대시보드는 아주 좋아 보입니다: 물류센터 출하 정시율 97%, 피킹 정확도 99%.

segments.src: Then your retail customer's scorecard arrives.
segments.tr: 그런데 그때 소매 고객사의 평가 점수표(scorecard)가 도착합니다.

segments.src: Large chains run **OTIF (on-time, in-full)** programs and charge suppliers for misses — Walmart's has assessed fees of roughly 3% of the value of noncompliant goods.
segments.tr: 대형 체인은 **OTIF(On-Time, In-Full, 정시·완전 납품)** 프로그램을 운영하며, 위반 시 공급업체에 비용을 청구합니다. 월마트의 경우 규정을 준수하지 않은 상품 가치의 약 3% 수준의 벌금을 부과한 사례가 있습니다.

segments.src: On $8 million of annual shipments to that account, a 10% miss rate is about $24,000 in fines, plus expedited freight to chase the shortfalls, plus a worse position in next year's negotiation.
segments.tr: 해당 고객에게 연간 800만 달러어치를 출하하는데 위반율이 10%라면, 벌금만 약 24,000달러이고, 부족분을 메우기 위한 특급 운송비에, 다음 해 협상에서의 불리한 입지까지 더해집니다.

segments.src: Then the port slows down for three weeks.
segments.tr: 그러던 중 항만이 3주간 느려집니다.

segments.src: You dig into your risk register and find the honest numbers: TTR for that ocean lane is 5 weeks; your TTS on current inventory is 3 weeks.
segments.tr: 위험 등록부를 살펴보니 현실적인 수치가 나옵니다: 해당 해상 노선의 TTR은 5주, 현재 재고 기준 TTS는 3주.

segments.src: Two weeks exposed.
segments.tr: 2주 동안 노출된 상태입니다.

segments.src: The options each carry a price you can actually compute — air freight a partial order at maybe $4–6 per kilogram versus roughly $0.30 by ocean, hold four extra weeks of safety stock at a carrying cost of 20–25% of inventory value per year, or qualify a second supplier at a few months of engineering time.
segments.tr: 선택지마다 실제로 계산 가능한 비용이 따릅니다. 부분 주문을 항공 운송하면 kg당 약 $4–6, 해상 운송은 약 $0.30입니다. 추가 안전 재고 4주를 보유하면 연간 재고가치의 20–25%에 해당하는 보관비가 듭니다. 또는 제2 공급업체를 승인하는 데 몇 달간의 엔지니어링 작업이 필요합니다.

segments.src: None of those choices is obvious.
segments.tr: 어느 선택지도 명백하지 않습니다.

segments.src: But once you've written down the perfect order rate, the fine schedule, TTR versus TTS, and the carrying cost, you're making a business decision instead of a guess.
segments.tr: 하지만 완전 주문 비율, 벌금 일정, TTR 대 TTS, 그리고 보관비를 적어 두고 나면, 추측이 아닌 경영 판단을 내리고 있는 것입니다.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## 세 줄 요약

segments.src: 1. Component metrics lie; end-to-end metrics like perfect order rate and cash-to-cash tell the truth, because errors multiply rather than average.
segments.tr: 1. 구성 지표는 착시를 일으킵니다. 완전 주문 비율과 현금 전환 사이클 같은 종단 간 지표가 진실을 말해 주는데, 오류는 평균되지 않고 곱해지기 때문입니다.

segments.src: 2. SCOR provides shared language and forces the trade-off — reliability, responsiveness, agility, cost, and assets cannot all be maximized at once.
segments.tr: 2. SCOR은 공통 언어를 제공하고 트레이드오프를 드러냅니다 — 신뢰성, 대응성, 민첩성, 비용, 자산은 동시에 모두 극대화할 수 없습니다.

segments.src: 3. Manage risk by comparing time-to-recover with time-to-survive rather than guessing probabilities, and treat emissions per ton-mile as a real KPI alongside cost.
segments.tr: 3. 확률을 추측하지 말고 복구 시간과 생존 시간을 비교하여 위험을 관리하며, 톤-마일당 배출량을 비용과 나란히 실제 KPI로 다루세요.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ 자가 점검 퀴즈

segments.src: **1.** A shipper hits 99% on-time, 98% complete, 99% damage-free, and 100% correct documentation.
segments.tr: **1.** 한 화주의 정시율이 99%, 완전성 98%, 무손상 99%, 서류 정확도 100%입니다.

segments.src: What is the perfect order rate?
segments.tr: 완전 주문 비율은 얼마입니까?

segments.src: (O/X)** A disruption with very low probability can safely be ignored in a risk register.
segments.tr: (O/X)** 발생 확률이 매우 낮은 위험은 위험 등록부에서 안전하게 무시해도 됩니다.

segments.src: **3.** Cash-to-cash cycle time is calculated as:
segments.tr: **3.** 현금 전환 사이클 시간은 다음과 같이 계산합니다:

segments.src: A) inventory days + receivable days − payable days
segments.tr: A) 재고일수 + 매출채권일수 − 매입채무일수

segments.src: B) receivable days + payable days − inventory days
segments.tr: B) 매출채권일수 + 매입채무일수 − 재고일수

segments.src: C) order cycle time + transit time
segments.tr: C) 주문 사이클 타임 + 운송 시간

segments.src: D) revenue ÷ average inventory
segments.tr: D) 매출 ÷ 평균 재고

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 오늘의 용어

segments.src: - **Perfect Order Rate** — Share of orders delivered on time, complete, undamaged, and correctly documented; the four rates multiply.
segments.tr: - **완전 주문 비율(Perfect Order Rate)** — 정시에, 완전하게, 손상 없이, 서류까지 올바르게 배송된 주문의 비율. 네 가지 비율을 곱합니다.

segments.src: - **SCOR** — The Supply Chain Operations Reference model, an ASCM-maintained standard for describing supply chain processes and scoring their performance.
segments.tr: - **SCOR** — 공급망 프로세스를 기술하고 성과를 평가하기 위해 ASCM이 관리하는 표준 모델인 공급망 운영 참조 모델.

segments.src: - **Cash-to-Cash Cycle Time** — Days of working capital tied up between paying suppliers and collecting from customers.
segments.tr: - **현금 전환 사이클 시간(Cash-to-Cash Cycle Time)** — 공급업체에 지급한 시점부터 고객에게서 대금을 회수할 때까지 운전자본이 묶여 있는 일수.

segments.src: - **TTR / TTS** — Time to Recover from a disrupted node versus Time to Survive on existing inventory; exposure exists when TTR is longer than TTS.
segments.tr: - **TTR / TTS** — 중단된 노드로부터 복구까지의 시간(TTR) 대 기존 재고로 버틸 수 있는 시간(TTS). TTR이 TTS보다 길면 노출이 존재합니다.

segments.src: - **Scope 3 Emissions** — Indirect emissions from purchased goods and outsourced transportation, typically the largest share of a shipper's carbon footprint.
segments.tr: - **Scope 3 배출** — 구매 물품과 외주 운송에서 발생하는 간접 배출로, 보통 화주 탄소 발자국에서 가장 큰 비중을 차지합니다.

segments.src: *Answers: 1 — C.
0.99 x 0.98 x 0.99 x 1.00 = 0.960, about 96%; four strong scores still leave four bad orders per hundred.
segments.tr: 0.99 x 0.98 x 0.99 x 1.00 = 0.960, 약 96%; 네 개의 우수한 점수가 있어도 100건당 여전히 네 건의 불량 주문이 남습니다.

segments.src: Rank by impact as well as likelihood; low-probability, high-impact events are exactly the ones that require a survival plan, since probability estimates for rare events are unreliable.
segments.tr: 발생 가능성뿐 아니라 영향도 기준으로 순위를 매기세요. 발생 확률이 낮고 영향이 큰 사건이야말로 생존 계획이 필요한 바로 그 사건이며, 희귀 사건의 확률 추정은 신뢰할 수 없기 때문입니다.

segments.src: Inventory days plus receivable days minus payable days; paying suppliers later and collecting sooner shortens the cycle.*

zh.title: [物流 101 #14] 98% 陷阱：为何“差不多准时”会让你真金白银地亏钱

segments.src: > A supply chain you can't measure is one you can't defend — this lesson covers the KPIs that matter, the SCOR framework that organizes them, how to price risk before it hits, and why emissions are becoming a logistics metric too.
segments.tr: > 无法衡量的供应链就无法守住——本课涵盖关键绩效指标、组织这些指标的 SCOR 框架、如何在风险发生前为其定价，以及为什么排放也正在成为物流指标。

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 今日概念

segments.src: Every warehouse manager will tell you things are "running fine."
segments.tr: 每位仓库经理都会告诉你一切“运转良好”。

segments.src: The job of performance measurement is to replace that sentence with a number.
segments.tr: 绩效衡量的任务，就是用一个数字取代这句话。

segments.src: **Start with KPIs — but the right ones.** The single most useful logistics metric is the **perfect order rate**: the share of orders delivered on time, complete, undamaged, and with correct paperwork.
segments.tr: **从 KPI 入手——但要选对指标。** 最有用的单一物流指标是**完美订单率**：即按时送达、数量齐全、完好无损且单证正确的订单占比。

segments.src: It's brutal because it multiplies:
segments.tr: 它之所以严苛，是因为它是相乘而非相加：

segments.src: Perfect order rate = on-time % x complete % x damage-free % x correct-docs %
segments.tr: Perfect order rate = on-time % x complete % x damage-free % x correct-docs %

segments.src: Four "excellent" 98% scores produce a 92% perfect order rate.
segments.tr: 四项看似“优秀”的 98% 得分，会得出 92% 的完美订单率。

segments.src: Eight orders in every hundred go wrong somewhere.
segments.tr: 每一百张订单中就有八张在某个环节出错。

segments.src: That gap between component metrics and end-to-end metrics is where most supply chain complaints live.
segments.tr: 单项指标与端到端指标之间的这种落差，正是大多数供应链投诉的根源。

segments.src: Other core measures:
segments.tr: 其他核心衡量指标：

segments.src: - **Order fulfillment cycle time** — order placed to customer receipt.
segments.tr: - **订单履行周期** — 从下单到客户收货的时间。

segments.src: - **Cash-to-cash cycle time** — days between paying your supplier and getting paid by your customer: `inventory days + receivable days - payable days`.
segments.tr: - **现金周转周期** — 从向供应商付款到收到客户付款之间的天数：`inventory days + receivable days - payable days`。

segments.src: - **Inventory turns** and **days of supply** — how hard your working capital is working.
segments.tr: - **库存周转次数**与**供应天数** — 衡量你的营运资金运转得有多高效。

segments.src: - **Cost to serve** — total logistics cost per order, per unit, or per customer.
segments.tr: - **服务成本** — 按订单、单位或客户计算的物流总成本。

segments.src: **SCOR gives these a home.** The Supply Chain Operations Reference model, maintained by ASCM, is the industry's standard vocabulary.
segments.tr: **SCOR 为这些指标提供了归属。** 由 ASCM 维护的供应链运营参考模型（SCOR）是行业标准术语体系。

segments.src: Classic SCOR organizes a supply chain into six process areas — Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, Return, and Enable — and scores them on five attributes: reliability, responsiveness, agility, cost, and asset management efficiency.
segments.tr: 经典 SCOR 将供应链划分为六个流程领域——计划（Plan）、采购（Source）、生产（Make）、交付（Deliver）、退货（Return）和支持（Enable）——并从五个属性对其评分：可靠性、响应性、敏捷性、成本和资产管理效率。

segments.src: The current digital revision (SCOR DS) renames and regroups those processes and folds in environmental and social measures alongside the economic ones.
segments.tr: 当前的数字化版本（SCOR DS）重新命名并重组了这些流程，并将环境与社会指标与经济指标一并纳入。

segments.src: The details shift between versions; the useful idea doesn't.
segments.tr: 具体细节随版本而变，但其核心思想不变。

segments.src: SCOR forces you to say *which attribute* you're optimizing, because you cannot maximize all five.
segments.tr: SCOR 迫使你明确说出自己在优化*哪一项属性*，因为五项属性无法同时最大化。

segments.src: Faster response usually costs more.
segments.tr: 响应更快通常意味着成本更高。

segments.src: Lower cost usually means less agility.
segments.tr: 成本更低通常意味着敏捷性更差。

segments.src: Pick, then measure.
segments.tr: 先做选择，再去衡量。

segments.src: **Risk management is measurement pointed at the future.** The standard move is a risk register: list what could break, score each item on **likelihood** and **impact**, and multiply to rank.
segments.tr: **风险管理是把衡量指向未来。** 标准做法是建立风险登记册：列出可能出问题的环节，依据**发生可能性**和**影响程度**为每项打分，再相乘进行排序。

segments.src: But logistics risk has a twist — the worst events are the low-probability ones, so probability estimates are close to worthless.
segments.tr: 但物流风险有个特殊之处——最严重的事件往往是低概率事件，因此概率估计几乎毫无价值。

segments.src: A more practical pair of questions, popularized by MIT's David Simchi-Levi:
segments.tr: 麻省理工学院的 David Simchi-Levi 推广了一组更实用的问题：

segments.src: - **Time to Recover (TTR):** if this node goes dark, how long until supply is restored?
segments.tr: - **恢复时间（TTR）：** 如果这个节点中断，多久才能恢复供应？

segments.src: - **Time to Survive (TTS):** how long can we keep serving customers on inventory and alternatives?
segments.tr: - **生存时间（TTS）：** 我们能依靠现有库存和替代方案继续服务客户多久？

segments.src: If TTR exceeds TTS, you have a real exposure, whatever the probability.
segments.tr: 无论概率高低，只要 TTR 超过 TTS，你就存在真实的风险敞口。

segments.src: The fixes are familiar: dual sourcing, safety stock at the right node, qualified backup carriers, postponement (finish the product late, closer to demand), and visibility into tier-2 and tier-3 suppliers — because the plant that shuts down is usually one your buyer has never heard of.
segments.tr: 应对方法并不陌生：双源采购、在合适节点设置安全库存、合格的备用承运商、延迟化（将产品的最后加工推迟到更接近需求时进行），以及掌握二级和三级供应商的可见性——因为停产的工厂通常是采购人员从未听说过的那家。

segments.src: **Sustainability is now a logistics KPI, not a press release.** Transportation and purchased goods sit in **Scope 3** emissions, which for most retailers and manufacturers dwarf their own facilities and fleet.
segments.tr: **可持续发展如今是物流 KPI，而非新闻稿上的口号。** 运输和采购商品都属于**范围 3**排放，对大多数零售商和制造商而言，这部分排放远超其自有设施和车队的排放。

segments.src: The operational levers are the same ones that cut cost: raise trailer load factor, cut **empty miles**, shift long hauls from truck to intermodal rail, right-size packaging, consolidate LTL shipments into full truckloads.
segments.tr: 可用的运营抓手与降低成本的手段相同：提高拖车装载率、减少**空驶里程**、将长途运输从公路转为多式联运铁路、优化包装尺寸、将零担运输整合为整车运输。

segments.src: Emissions per ton-mile is the metric; the EPA's SmartWay program is the common US benchmark for carrier performance.
segments.tr: 衡量指标是每吨公里排放量；美国环保署的 SmartWay 计划是常用的承运商绩效基准。

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 日常生活中的例子

segments.src: Say you run a Columbus, Ohio distributor selling houseware to a big-box retailer.
segments.tr: 假设你经营一家位于俄亥俄州哥伦布市的经销商，向大型连锁零售商供应家居用品。

segments.src: Your goods move from a supplier in Vietnam, through the Port of Long Beach, by rail to Chicago, then by truck to your DC.
segments.tr: 你的货物从越南供应商出发，经由长滩港，经铁路运至芝加哥，再由卡车运往你的配送中心。

segments.src: Your internal dashboard looks great: 97% on-time from the DC, 99% pick accuracy.
segments.tr: 你的内部仪表盘看起来很不错：配送中心准时发货率 97%，拣货准确率 99%。

segments.src: Then your retail customer's scorecard arrives.
segments.tr: 随后，零售客户的评分卡送到了。

segments.src: Large chains run **OTIF (on-time, in-full)** programs and charge suppliers for misses — Walmart's has assessed fees of roughly 3% of the value of noncompliant goods.
segments.tr: 大型连锁店会推行 **OTIF（准时且足量）** 计划，并对供应商的未达标行为收费——沃尔玛的收费标准约为不合规商品价值的 3%。

segments.src: On $8 million of annual shipments to that account, a 10% miss rate is about $24,000 in fines, plus expedited freight to chase the shortfalls, plus a worse position in next year's negotiation.
segments.tr: 若该客户每年的发货额为 800 万美元，10% 的未达标率将产生约 24,000 美元罚款，外加为弥补缺货而支付的加急运费，以及明年谈判时更为不利的地位。

segments.src: Then the port slows down for three weeks.
segments.tr: 接着，港口出现了为期三周的拥堵。

segments.src: You dig into your risk register and find the honest numbers: TTR for that ocean lane is 5 weeks; your TTS on current inventory is 3 weeks.
segments.tr: 你翻查风险登记册，找到了真实的数据：该海运航线的 TTR 为 5 周；按现有库存计算，你的 TTS 为 3 周。

segments.src: Two weeks exposed.
segments.tr: 这意味着有两周的风险敞口。

segments.src: The options each carry a price you can actually compute — air freight a partial order at maybe $4–6 per kilogram versus roughly $0.30 by ocean, hold four extra weeks of safety stock at a carrying cost of 20–25% of inventory value per year, or qualify a second supplier at a few months of engineering time.
segments.tr: 每种选择都有可以实际计算的成本——部分订单空运，每公斤约 4–6 美元，而海运约为 0.30 美元；额外持有四周安全库存，每年的持有成本为库存价值的 20–25%；或者认证第二家供应商，需要数月的工程时间。

segments.src: None of those choices is obvious.
segments.tr: 这些选择都不是显而易见的。

segments.src: But once you've written down the perfect order rate, the fine schedule, TTR versus TTS, and the carrying cost, you're making a business decision instead of a guess.
segments.tr: 但当你把完美订单率、罚款规则、TTR 与 TTS 的对比以及持有成本都写下来之后，你做的就是商业决策，而不是猜测。

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## 三句话总结

segments.src: 1. Component metrics lie; end-to-end metrics like perfect order rate and cash-to-cash tell the truth, because errors multiply rather than average.
segments.tr: 1. 单项指标会误导人；完美订单率和现金周转周期等端到端指标才反映真相，因为错误是相乘而非取平均。

segments.src: 2. SCOR provides shared language and forces the trade-off — reliability, responsiveness, agility, cost, and assets cannot all be maximized at once.
segments.tr: 2. SCOR 提供了通用语言，并迫使人们权衡取舍——可靠性、响应性、敏捷性、成本和资产不可能同时达到最大化。

segments.src: 3. Manage risk by comparing time-to-recover with time-to-survive rather than guessing probabilities, and treat emissions per ton-mile as a real KPI alongside cost.
segments.tr: 3. 通过比较恢复时间与生存时间来管理风险，而不是猜测概率；并将每吨公里排放量与成本一起视为真正的 KPI。

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ 自测题

segments.src: **1.** A shipper hits 99% on-time, 98% complete, 99% damage-free, and 100% correct documentation.
segments.tr: **1.** 某托运人的准时率为 99%、齐全率为 98%、无损率为 99%、单证正确率为 100%。

segments.src: What is the perfect order rate?
segments.tr: 其完美订单率是多少？

segments.src: (O/X)** A disruption with very low probability can safely be ignored in a risk register.
segments.tr: (O/X)** 在风险登记册中，发生概率极低的中断可以放心忽略。

segments.src: **3.** Cash-to-cash cycle time is calculated as:
segments.tr: **3.** 现金周转周期的计算方式为：

segments.src: A) inventory days + receivable days − payable days
segments.tr: A) 库存天数 + 应收账款天数 − 应付账款天数

segments.src: B) receivable days + payable days − inventory days
segments.tr: B) 应收账款天数 + 应付账款天数 − 库存天数

segments.src: C) order cycle time + transit time
segments.tr: C) 订单周期 + 运输时间

segments.src: D) revenue ÷ average inventory
segments.tr: D) 营收 ÷ 平均库存

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 今日术语

segments.src: - **Perfect Order Rate** — Share of orders delivered on time, complete, undamaged, and correctly documented; the four rates multiply.
segments.tr: - **完美订单率（Perfect Order Rate）** — 按时送达、数量齐全、完好无损且单证正确的订单占比；四项比率相乘得出。

segments.src: - **SCOR** — The Supply Chain Operations Reference model, an ASCM-maintained standard for describing supply chain processes and scoring their performance.
segments.tr: - **SCOR** — 供应链运营参考模型，由 ASCM 维护的标准，用于描述供应链流程并评估其绩效。

segments.src: - **Cash-to-Cash Cycle Time** — Days of working capital tied up between paying suppliers and collecting from customers.
segments.tr: - **现金周转周期（Cash-to-Cash Cycle Time）** — 从向供应商付款到收回客户款项之间，营运资金被占用的天数。

segments.src: - **TTR / TTS** — Time to Recover from a disrupted node versus Time to Survive on existing inventory; exposure exists when TTR is longer than TTS.
segments.tr: - **TTR / TTS** — 从中断节点恢复所需的时间与依靠现有库存维持服务的时间；当 TTR 长于 TTS 时即存在风险敞口。

segments.src: - **Scope 3 Emissions** — Indirect emissions from purchased goods and outsourced transportation, typically the largest share of a shipper's carbon footprint.
segments.tr: - **范围 3 排放（Scope 3 Emissions）** — 采购商品和外包运输产生的间接排放，通常占托运人碳足迹的最大份额。

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## आज की अवधारणा

segments.src: Every warehouse manager will tell you things are "running fine."

segments.tr: प्रदर्शन मापन का काम उस वाक्य की जगह एक संख्या रखना है।

segments.src: **Start with KPIs — but the right ones.** The single most useful logistics metric is the **perfect order rate**: the share of orders delivered on time, complete, undamaged, and with correct paperwork.
segments.tr: **KPI से शुरुआत करें — लेकिन सही KPI से।** सबसे उपयोगी लॉजिस्टिक्स मेट्रिक **परफेक्ट ऑर्डर रेट** है: वे ऑर्डर का अनुपात जो समय पर, पूरे, बिना क्षति के और सही दस्तावेज़ों के साथ पहुँचाए गए हों।

segments.src: It's brutal because it multiplies:
segments.tr: यह कठोर है क्योंकि यह गुणा होता है:

segments.src: Perfect order rate = on-time % x complete % x damage-free % x correct-docs %
segments.tr: Perfect order rate = on-time % x complete % x damage-free % x correct-docs %

segments.src: Four "excellent" 98% scores produce a 92% perfect order rate.
segments.tr: चार "उत्कृष्ट" 98% स्कोर मिलकर 92% परफेक्ट ऑर्डर रेट देते हैं।

segments.src: Eight orders in every hundred go wrong somewhere.
segments.tr: हर सौ में से आठ ऑर्डर कहीं न कहीं गड़बड़ हो जाते हैं।

segments.src: That gap between component metrics and end-to-end metrics is where most supply chain complaints live.
segments.tr: घटक मेट्रिक्स और एंड-टू-एंड मेट्रिक्स के बीच का यही अंतर है, जहाँ अधिकांश सप्लाई चेन की शिकायतें पनपती हैं।

segments.src: Other core measures:
segments.tr: अन्य प्रमुख माप:

segments.src: - **Order fulfillment cycle time** — order placed to customer receipt.
segments.tr: - **ऑर्डर पूर्ति चक्र समय** — ऑर्डर देने से लेकर ग्राहक द्वारा प्राप्ति तक।

segments.src: - **Cash-to-cash cycle time** — days between paying your supplier and getting paid by your customer: `inventory days + receivable days - payable days`.
segments.tr: - **कैश-टू-कैश चक्र समय** — आपके आपूर्तिकर्ता को भुगतान करने और आपके ग्राहक से भुगतान प्राप्त करने के बीच के दिन: `inventory days + receivable days - payable days`।

segments.src: - **Inventory turns** and **days of supply** — how hard your working capital is working.
segments.tr: - **इन्वेंटरी टर्न** और **आपूर्ति के दिन** — आपकी कार्यशील पूँजी कितनी मेहनत से काम कर रही है।

segments.src: - **Cost to serve** — total logistics cost per order, per unit, or per customer.
segments.tr: - **सर्व करने की लागत** — प्रति ऑर्डर, प्रति इकाई या प्रति ग्राहक कुल लॉजिस्टिक्स लागत।

segments.src: **SCOR gives these a home.** The Supply Chain Operations Reference model, maintained by ASCM, is the industry's standard vocabulary.
segments.tr: **SCOR इन सबको एक ठिकाना देता है।** सप्लाई चेन ऑपरेशंस रेफ़रेंस मॉडल, जिसे ASCM बनाए रखता है, उद्योग की मानक शब्दावली है।

segments.src: Classic SCOR organizes a supply chain into six process areas — Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, Return, and Enable — and scores them on five attributes: reliability, responsiveness, agility, cost, and asset management efficiency.
segments.tr: क्लासिक SCOR सप्लाई चेन को छह प्रक्रिया क्षेत्रों में व्यवस्थित करता है — Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, Return और Enable — और उन्हें पाँच गुणों पर आँकता है: विश्वसनीयता, प्रतिक्रियाशीलता, चपलता, लागत और परिसंपत्ति प्रबंधन दक्षता।

segments.src: The current digital revision (SCOR DS) renames and regroups those processes and folds in environmental and social measures alongside the economic ones.
segments.tr: वर्तमान डिजिटल संशोधन (SCOR DS) उन प्रक्रियाओं का नाम बदलता और पुनर्समूहन करता है, और आर्थिक मापों के साथ पर्यावरणीय और सामाजिक मापों को भी शामिल करता है।

segments.src: The details shift between versions; the useful idea doesn't.
segments.tr: विवरण संस्करणों के बीच बदलते हैं; उपयोगी विचार नहीं बदलता।

segments.src: SCOR forces you to say *which attribute* you're optimizing, because you cannot maximize all five.
segments.tr: SCOR आपको यह बताने के लिए मजबूर करता है कि आप *किस गुण* को अनुकूलित कर रहे हैं, क्योंकि आप पाँचों को अधिकतम नहीं कर सकते।

segments.src: Faster response usually costs more.
segments.tr: तेज़ प्रतिक्रिया आमतौर पर अधिक महंगी पड़ती है।

segments.src: Lower cost usually means less agility.
segments.tr: कम लागत आमतौर पर कम चपलता का अर्थ होती है।

segments.src: Pick, then measure.
segments.tr: पहले चुनें, फिर मापें।

segments.src: **Risk management is measurement pointed at the future.** The standard move is a risk register: list what could break, score each item on **likelihood** and **impact**, and multiply to rank.
segments.tr: **जोखिम प्रबंधन भविष्य की ओर इशारा करने वाला मापन है।** मानक तरीका एक जोखिम रजिस्टर है: सूचीबद्ध करें कि क्या टूट सकता है, हर आइटम को **संभावना** और **प्रभाव** पर आँकें, और रैंक के लिए गुणा करें।

segments.src: But logistics risk has a twist — the worst events are the low-probability ones, so probability estimates are close to worthless.
segments.tr: लेकिन लॉजिस्टिक्स जोखिम में एक मोड़ है — सबसे बुरी घटनाएँ कम-संभावना वाली होती हैं, इसलिए संभावना के अनुमान लगभग बेकार होते हैं।

segments.src: A more practical pair of questions, popularized by MIT's David Simchi-Levi:
segments.tr: प्रश्नों की एक अधिक व्यावहारिक जोड़ी, जिसे MIT के David Simchi-Levi ने लोकप्रिय बनाया:

segments.src: - **Time to Recover (TTR):** if this node goes dark, how long until supply is restored?
segments.tr: - **पुनर्प्राप्ति का समय (TTR):** यदि यह नोड ठप हो जाए, तो आपूर्ति बहाल होने में कितना समय लगेगा?

segments.src: - **Time to Survive (TTS):** how long can we keep serving customers on inventory and alternatives?
segments.tr: - **जीवित रहने का समय (TTS):** हम इन्वेंटरी और विकल्पों के सहारे ग्राहकों को कब तक सेवा दे सकते हैं?

segments.src: If TTR exceeds TTS, you have a real exposure, whatever the probability.
segments.tr: यदि TTR, TTS से अधिक हो, तो संभावना चाहे जो भी हो, आपके लिए वास्तविक जोखिम है।

segments.src: The fixes are familiar: dual sourcing, safety stock at the right node, qualified backup carriers, postponement (finish the product late, closer to demand), and visibility into tier-2 and tier-3 suppliers — because the plant that shuts down is usually one your buyer has never heard of.
segments.tr: समाधान परिचित हैं: दोहरी सोर्सिंग, सही नोड पर सेफ्टी स्टॉक, योग्य बैकअप कैरियर, पोस्टपोनमेंट (उत्पाद को देर से, मांग के नज़दीक पूरा करना), और टियर-2 व टियर-3 आपूर्तिकर्ताओं की दृश्यता — क्योंकि जो प्लांट बंद होता है, वह आमतौर पर वह होता है जिसके बारे में आपके खरीदार ने कभी सुना तक नहीं होता।

segments.src: **Sustainability is now a logistics KPI, not a press release.** Transportation and purchased goods sit in **Scope 3** emissions, which for most retailers and manufacturers dwarf their own facilities and fleet.
segments.tr: **स्थिरता अब एक प्रेस विज्ञप्ति नहीं, बल्कि एक लॉजिस्टिक्स KPI है।** परिवहन और खरीदे गए माल **Scope 3** उत्सर्जन में आते हैं, जो अधिकांश खुदरा विक्रेताओं और निर्माताओं के लिए उनकी अपनी सुविधाओं और बेड़े से कहीं बड़े होते हैं।

segments.src: The operational levers are the same ones that cut cost: raise trailer load factor, cut **empty miles**, shift long hauls from truck to intermodal rail, right-size packaging, consolidate LTL shipments into full truckloads.
segments.tr: परिचालन के लीवर वही हैं जो लागत घटाते हैं: ट्रेलर लोड फ़ैक्टर बढ़ाना, **खाली मील** घटाना, लंबी ढुलाई को ट्रक से इंटरमोडल रेल पर ले जाना, पैकेजिंग का सही आकार तय करना, LTL शिपमेंट को पूरे ट्रकलोड में समेकित करना।

segments.src: Emissions per ton-mile is the metric; the EPA's SmartWay program is the common US benchmark for carrier performance.
segments.tr: प्रति टन-मील उत्सर्जन ही वह मेट्रिक है; EPA का SmartWay कार्यक्रम कैरियर प्रदर्शन के लिए आम अमेरिकी बेंचमार्क है।

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## रोज़मर्रा के जीवन में

segments.src: Say you run a Columbus, Ohio distributor selling houseware to a big-box retailer.
segments.tr: मान लीजिए आप Columbus, Ohio में एक वितरक चलाते हैं जो एक बड़े बॉक्स रिटेलर को घरेलू सामान बेचता है।

segments.src: Your goods move from a supplier in Vietnam, through the Port of Long Beach, by rail to Chicago, then by truck to your DC.
segments.tr: आपका माल वियतनाम के एक आपूर्तिकर्ता से चलकर Long Beach बंदरगाह से होते हुए रेल द्वारा Chicago और फिर ट्रक द्वारा आपके DC तक पहुँचता है।

segments.src: Your internal dashboard looks great: 97% on-time from the DC, 99% pick accuracy.
segments.tr: आपका आंतरिक डैशबोर्ड बढ़िया दिखता है: DC से 97% समय पर डिलीवरी, 99% पिक सटीकता।

segments.src: Then your retail customer's scorecard arrives.
segments.tr: फिर आपके खुदरा ग्राहक का स्कोरकार्ड आता है।

segments.src: Large chains run **OTIF (on-time, in-full)** programs and charge suppliers for misses — Walmart's has assessed fees of roughly 3% of the value of noncompliant goods.
segments.tr: बड़ी चेन **OTIF (on-time, in-full)** कार्यक्रम चलाती हैं और चूक के लिए आपूर्तिकर्ताओं से शुल्क लेती हैं — Walmart के कार्यक्रम ने गैर-अनुपालक माल के मूल्य का लगभग 3% शुल्क आँका है।

segments.src: On $8 million of annual shipments to that account, a 10% miss rate is about $24,000 in fines, plus expedited freight to chase the shortfalls, plus a worse position in next year's negotiation.
segments.tr: उस खाते को सालाना $8 मिलियन की शिपमेंट पर, 10% चूक दर का मतलब लगभग $24,000 का जुर्माना है, साथ ही कमी की भरपाई के लिए तेज़ माल ढुलाई, और अगले साल की बातचीत में कमज़ोर स्थिति।

segments.src: Then the port slows down for three weeks.
segments.tr: फिर बंदरगाह तीन हफ़्तों के लिए धीमा हो जाता है।

segments.src: You dig into your risk register and find the honest numbers: TTR for that ocean lane is 5 weeks; your TTS on current inventory is 3 weeks.
segments.tr: आप अपने जोखिम रजिस्टर को खंगालते हैं और सच्चे आँकड़े पाते हैं: उस समुद्री मार्ग के लिए TTR 5 हफ़्ते है; मौजूदा इन्वेंटरी पर आपका TTS 3 हफ़्ते है।

segments.src: Two weeks exposed.
segments.tr: दो हफ़्ते का जोखिम।

segments.src: The options each carry a price you can actually compute — air freight a partial order at maybe $4–6 per kilogram versus roughly $0.30 by ocean, hold four extra weeks of safety stock at a carrying cost of 20–25% of inventory value per year, or qualify a second supplier at a few months of engineering time.
segments.tr: हर विकल्प की एक ऐसी कीमत है जिसकी आप वास्तव में गणना कर सकते हैं — आंशिक ऑर्डर को हवाई माल से भेजना, जो शायद प्रति किलोग्राम $4–6 पड़ेगा, बनाम समुद्र से लगभग $0.30; प्रति वर्ष इन्वेंटरी मूल्य के 20–25% की वहन लागत पर चार अतिरिक्त हफ़्तों का सेफ्टी स्टॉक रखना; या कुछ महीनों के इंजीनियरिंग समय में दूसरे आपूर्तिकर्ता को योग्य बनाना।

segments.src: None of those choices is obvious.
segments.tr: इनमें से कोई भी विकल्प स्पष्ट नहीं है।

segments.src: But once you've written down the perfect order rate, the fine schedule, TTR versus TTS, and the carrying cost, you're making a business decision instead of a guess.
segments.tr: लेकिन एक बार जब आप परफेक्ट ऑर्डर रेट, जुर्माने का शेड्यूल, TTR बनाम TTS, और वहन लागत लिख लेते हैं, तो आप अनुमान के बजाय एक व्यावसायिक निर्णय ले रहे होते हैं।

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## तीन पंक्तियों में सारांश

segments.src: 1. Component metrics lie; end-to-end metrics like perfect order rate and cash-to-cash tell the truth, because errors multiply rather than average.
segments.tr: 1. घटक मेट्रिक्स भ्रामक होते हैं; परफेक्ट ऑर्डर रेट और कैश-टू-कैश जैसे एंड-टू-एंड मेट्रिक्स सच बताते हैं, क्योंकि त्रुटियाँ औसत नहीं, गुणा होती हैं।

segments.src: 2. SCOR provides shared language and forces the trade-off — reliability, responsiveness, agility, cost, and assets cannot all be maximized at once.
segments.tr: 2. SCOR साझा भाषा देता है और ट्रेड-ऑफ़ को अनिवार्य बनाता है — विश्वसनीयता, प्रतिक्रियाशीलता, चपलता, लागत और परिसंपत्तियाँ एक साथ अधिकतम नहीं की जा सकतीं।

segments.src: 3. Manage risk by comparing time-to-recover with time-to-survive rather than guessing probabilities, and treat emissions per ton-mile as a real KPI alongside cost.
segments.tr: 3. संभावनाओं का अनुमान लगाने के बजाय पुनर्प्राप्ति समय की तुलना जीवित रहने के समय से करके जोखिम प्रबंधित करें, और प्रति टन-मील उत्सर्जन को लागत के साथ एक वास्तविक KPI मानें।

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ स्व-परीक्षा

segments.src: **1.** A shipper hits 99% on-time, 98% complete, 99% damage-free, and 100% correct documentation.
segments.tr: **1.** एक शिपर 99% समय पर, 98% पूर्ण, 99% बिना क्षति, और 100% सही दस्तावेज़ीकरण हासिल करता है।

segments.src: What is the perfect order rate?
segments.tr: परफेक्ट ऑर्डर रेट क्या है?

segments.src: (O/X)** A disruption with very low probability can safely be ignored in a risk register.
segments.tr: (O/X)** बहुत कम संभावना वाले किसी व्यवधान को जोखिम रजिस्टर में सुरक्षित रूप से नज़रअंदाज़ किया जा सकता है।

segments.src: **3.** Cash-to-cash cycle time is calculated as:
segments.tr: **3.** कैश-टू-कैश चक्र समय की गणना इस प्रकार की जाती है:

segments.src: A) inventory days + receivable days − payable days
segments.tr: A) इन्वेंटरी दिन + प्राप्य दिन − देय दिन

segments.src: B) receivable days + payable days − inventory days
segments.tr: B) प्राप्य दिन + देय दिन − इन्वेंटरी दिन

segments.src: C) order cycle time + transit time
segments.tr: C) ऑर्डर चक्र समय + पारगमन समय

segments.src: D) revenue ÷ average inventory
segments.tr: D) राजस्व ÷ औसत इन्वेंटरी

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 आज के शब्द

segments.src: - **Perfect Order Rate** — Share of orders delivered on time, complete, undamaged, and correctly documented; the four rates multiply.
segments.tr: - **परफेक्ट ऑर्डर रेट** — वे ऑर्डर का अनुपात जो समय पर, पूरे, बिना क्षति के और सही दस्तावेज़ीकरण के साथ पहुँचाए गए हों; चारों दरें आपस में गुणा होती हैं।

segments.src: - **SCOR** — The Supply Chain Operations Reference model, an ASCM-maintained standard for describing supply chain processes and scoring their performance.
segments.tr: - **SCOR** — सप्लाई चेन ऑपरेशंस रेफ़रेंस मॉडल, ASCM द्वारा बनाए रखा गया एक मानक, जो सप्लाई चेन प्रक्रियाओं के वर्णन और उनके प्रदर्शन की स्कोरिंग के लिए है।

segments.src: - **Cash-to-Cash Cycle Time** — Days of working capital tied up between paying suppliers and collecting from customers.
segments.tr: - **कैश-टू-कैश चक्र समय** — आपूर्तिकर्ताओं को भुगतान करने और ग्राहकों से वसूली के बीच फँसी कार्यशील पूँजी के दिन।

segments.src: - **TTR / TTS** — Time to Recover from a disrupted node versus Time to Survive on existing inventory; exposure exists when TTR is longer than TTS.
segments.tr: - **TTR / TTS** — बाधित नोड से पुनर्प्राप्ति का समय बनाम मौजूदा इन्वेंटरी पर जीवित रहने का समय; जब TTR, TTS से लंबा हो तब जोखिम मौजूद होता है।

segments.src: - **Scope 3 Emissions** — Indirect emissions from purchased goods and outsourced transportation, typically the largest share of a shipper's carbon footprint.
segments.tr: - **Scope 3 उत्सर्जन** — खरीदे गए माल और आउटसोर्स परिवहन से होने वाला अप्रत्यक्ष उत्सर्जन, जो आमतौर पर किसी शिपर के कार्बन फुटप्रिंट का सबसे बड़ा हिस्सा होता है।

segments.src: Rank by impact as well as likelihood; low-probability, high-impact events are exactly the ones that require a survival plan, since probability estimates for rare events are unreliable.
segments.tr: संभावना के साथ-साथ प्रभाव के आधार पर रैंक करें; कम-संभावना, उच्च-प्रभाव वाली घटनाएँ ठीक वही हैं जिनके लिए एक जीवित रहने की योजना चाहिए, क्योंकि दुर्लभ घटनाओं के संभावना अनुमान विश्वसनीय नहीं होते।

segments.src: Inventory days plus receivable days minus payable days; paying suppliers later and collecting sooner shortens the cycle.*
segments.tr: इन्वेंटरी दिन और प्राप्य दिन का जोड़, घटाकर देय दिन; आपूर्तिकर्ताओं को बाद में भुगतान करने और जल्दी वसूली करने से चक्र छोटा होता है।*

es.title: [Logística 101 #14] La trampa del 98%: por qué «casi a tiempo» te cuesta dinero real

segments.src: > A supply chain you can't measure is one you can't defend — this lesson covers the KPIs that matter, the SCOR framework that organizes them, how to price risk before it hits, and why emissions are becoming a logistics metric too.
segments.tr: > Una cadena de suministro que no puedes medir es una que no puedes defender — esta lección cubre los KPI que importan, el marco SCOR que los organiza, cómo valorar el riesgo antes de que se materialice y por qué las emisiones también se están convirtiendo en una métrica logística.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Concepto de hoy

segments.src: Every warehouse manager will tell you things are "running fine."
segments.tr: Todo gerente de almacén te dirá que las cosas "van bien".

segments.src: The job of performance measurement is to replace that sentence with a number.
segments.tr: La función de la medición de desempeño es reemplazar esa frase por un número.

segments.src: **Start with KPIs — but the right ones.** The single most useful logistics metric is the **perfect order rate**: the share of orders delivered on time, complete, undamaged, and with correct paperwork.
segments.tr: **Empieza por los KPI, pero los correctos.** La métrica logística más útil es la **tasa de pedido perfecto**: la proporción de pedidos entregados a tiempo, completos, sin daños y con la documentación correcta.

segments.src: It's brutal because it multiplies:
segments.tr: Es brutal porque se multiplica:

segments.src: Perfect order rate = on-time % x complete % x damage-free % x correct-docs %
segments.tr: Perfect order rate = on-time % x complete % x damage-free % x correct-docs %

segments.src: Four "excellent" 98% scores produce a 92% perfect order rate.
segments.tr: Cuatro puntuaciones "excelentes" de 98% producen una tasa de pedido perfecto de 92%.

segments.src: Eight orders in every hundred go wrong somewhere.
segments.tr: Ocho de cada cien pedidos salen mal en algún punto.

segments.src: That gap between component metrics and end-to-end metrics is where most supply chain complaints live.
segments.tr: Esa brecha entre las métricas de componentes y las métricas de extremo a extremo es donde viven la mayoría de las quejas sobre la cadena de suministro.

segments.src: Other core measures:
segments.tr: Otras medidas básicas:

segments.src: - **Order fulfillment cycle time** — order placed to customer receipt.
segments.tr: - **Tiempo de ciclo del cumplimiento de pedidos** — desde que se realiza el pedido hasta que el cliente lo recibe.

segments.src: - **Cash-to-cash cycle time** — days between paying your supplier and getting paid by your customer: `inventory days + receivable days - payable days`.
segments.tr: - **Tiempo de ciclo cash-to-cash** — días entre que pagas a tu proveedor y cobras a tu cliente: `inventory days + receivable days - payable days`.

segments.src: - **Inventory turns** and **days of supply** — how hard your working capital is working.
segments.tr: - **Rotación de inventario** y **días de suministro** — qué tan bien trabaja tu capital de trabajo.

segments.src: - **Cost to serve** — total logistics cost per order, per unit, or per customer.
segments.tr: - **Costo de servir** — costo logístico total por pedido, por unidad o por cliente.

segments.src: **SCOR gives these a home.** The Supply Chain Operations Reference model, maintained by ASCM, is the industry's standard vocabulary.
segments.tr: **SCOR les da un hogar.** El modelo Supply Chain Operations Reference, mantenido por ASCM, es el vocabulario estándar de la industria.

segments.src: Classic SCOR organizes a supply chain into six process areas — Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, Return, and Enable — and scores them on five attributes: reliability, responsiveness, agility, cost, and asset management efficiency.
segments.tr: El SCOR clásico organiza una cadena de suministro en seis áreas de proceso — Planificar, Abastecer, Producir, Entregar, Devolver y Habilitar — y las evalúa según cinco atributos: confiabilidad, capacidad de respuesta, agilidad, costo y eficiencia en el uso de activos.

segments.src: The current digital revision (SCOR DS) renames and regroups those processes and folds in environmental and social measures alongside the economic ones.
segments.tr: La revisión digital actual (SCOR DS) renombra y reagrupa esos procesos e incorpora medidas ambientales y sociales junto a las económicas.

segments.src: The details shift between versions; the useful idea doesn't.
segments.tr: Los detalles cambian entre versiones; la idea útil no.

segments.src: SCOR forces you to say *which attribute* you're optimizing, because you cannot maximize all five.
segments.tr: SCOR te obliga a decir *qué atributo* estás optimizando, porque no puedes maximizar los cinco.

segments.src: Faster response usually costs more.
segments.tr: Responder más rápido suele costar más.

segments.src: Lower cost usually means less agility.
segments.tr: Un costo menor suele significar menos agilidad.

segments.src: Pick, then measure.
segments.tr: Elige, y luego mide.

segments.src: **Risk management is measurement pointed at the future.** The standard move is a risk register: list what could break, score each item on **likelihood** and **impact**, and multiply to rank.
segments.tr: **La gestión de riesgos es medición apuntada al futuro.** La jugada estándar es un registro de riesgos: enumera lo que podría fallar, puntúa cada elemento según **probabilidad** e **impacto**, y multiplica para ordenar.

segments.src: But logistics risk has a twist — the worst events are the low-probability ones, so probability estimates are close to worthless.
segments.tr: Pero el riesgo logístico tiene un giro: los peores eventos son los de baja probabilidad, así que las estimaciones de probabilidad casi no sirven.

segments.src: A more practical pair of questions, popularized by MIT's David Simchi-Levi:
segments.tr: Un par de preguntas más prácticas, popularizadas por David Simchi-Levi del MIT:

segments.src: - **Time to Recover (TTR):** if this node goes dark, how long until supply is restored?
segments.tr: - **Tiempo para recuperarse (TTR):** si este nodo deja de funcionar, ¿cuánto tarda en restablecerse el suministro?

segments.src: - **Time to Survive (TTS):** how long can we keep serving customers on inventory and alternatives?
segments.tr: - **Tiempo para sobrevivir (TTS):** ¿cuánto tiempo podemos seguir atendiendo a los clientes con inventario y alternativas?

segments.src: If TTR exceeds TTS, you have a real exposure, whatever the probability.
segments.tr: Si el TTR supera al TTS, tienes una exposición real, sea cual sea la probabilidad.

segments.src: The fixes are familiar: dual sourcing, safety stock at the right node, qualified backup carriers, postponement (finish the product late, closer to demand), and visibility into tier-2 and tier-3 suppliers — because the plant that shuts down is usually one your buyer has never heard of.
segments.tr: Las soluciones son conocidas: doble abastecimiento, inventario de seguridad en el nodo correcto, transportistas de respaldo calificados, postergación (terminar el producto tarde, más cerca de la demanda) y visibilidad sobre proveedores de segundo y tercer nivel, porque la planta que cierra suele ser una de la que tu comprador nunca ha oído hablar.

segments.src: **Sustainability is now a logistics KPI, not a press release.** Transportation and purchased goods sit in **Scope 3** emissions, which for most retailers and manufacturers dwarf their own facilities and fleet.
segments.tr: **La sostenibilidad ya es un KPI logístico, no un comunicado de prensa.** El transporte y los bienes comprados forman parte de las emisiones de **Alcance 3**, que para la mayoría de minoristas y fabricantes superan con creces a sus propias instalaciones y flota.

segments.src: The operational levers are the same ones that cut cost: raise trailer load factor, cut **empty miles**, shift long hauls from truck to intermodal rail, right-size packaging, consolidate LTL shipments into full truckloads.
segments.tr: Las palancas operativas son las mismas que reducen costos: aumentar el factor de carga de los remolques, reducir los **viajes en vacío**, trasladar los trayectos largos del camión al ferrocarril intermodal, ajustar el tamaño del empaque y consolidar envíos LTL en cargas completas.

segments.src: Emissions per ton-mile is the metric; the EPA's SmartWay program is the common US benchmark for carrier performance.
segments.tr: Las emisiones por tonelada-milla son la métrica; el programa SmartWay de la EPA es el referente estadounidense común para el desempeño de los transportistas.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## En la vida cotidiana

segments.src: Say you run a Columbus, Ohio distributor selling houseware to a big-box retailer.
segments.tr: Supón que diriges un distribuidor en Columbus, Ohio, que vende artículos para el hogar a una gran cadena de tiendas.

segments.src: Your goods move from a supplier in Vietnam, through the Port of Long Beach, by rail to Chicago, then by truck to your DC.
segments.tr: Tu mercancía viaja desde un proveedor en Vietnam, pasa por el Puerto de Long Beach, va en tren hasta Chicago y luego en camión hasta tu centro de distribución.

segments.src: Your internal dashboard looks great: 97% on-time from the DC, 99% pick accuracy.
segments.tr: Tu panel interno se ve excelente: 97% de entregas a tiempo desde el CD, 99% de precisión en el picking.

segments.src: Then your retail customer's scorecard arrives.
segments.tr: Luego llega la tarjeta de desempeño de tu cliente minorista.

segments.src: Large chains run **OTIF (on-time, in-full)** programs and charge suppliers for misses — Walmart's has assessed fees of roughly 3% of the value of noncompliant goods.
segments.tr: Las grandes cadenas manejan programas **OTIF (a tiempo y completo, on-time in-full)** y cobran a los proveedores por los incumplimientos — el de Walmart ha impuesto multas de aproximadamente el 3% del valor de la mercancía no conforme.

segments.src: On $8 million of annual shipments to that account, a 10% miss rate is about $24,000 in fines, plus expedited freight to chase the shortfalls, plus a worse position in next year's negotiation.
segments.tr: Con $8 millones de envíos anuales a esa cuenta, una tasa de incumplimiento del 10% equivale a unos $24,000 en multas, más el flete urgente para recuperar los faltantes, más una peor posición en la negociación del próximo año.

segments.src: Then the port slows down for three weeks.
segments.tr: Luego el puerto se ralentiza durante tres semanas.

segments.src: You dig into your risk register and find the honest numbers: TTR for that ocean lane is 5 weeks; your TTS on current inventory is 3 weeks.
segments.tr: Revisas tu registro de riesgos y encuentras las cifras reales: el TTR de esa ruta marítima es de 5 semanas; tu TTS con el inventario actual es de 3 semanas.

segments.src: Two weeks exposed.
segments.tr: Dos semanas expuesto.

segments.src: The options each carry a price you can actually compute — air freight a partial order at maybe $4–6 per kilogram versus roughly $0.30 by ocean, hold four extra weeks of safety stock at a carrying cost of 20–25% of inventory value per year, or qualify a second supplier at a few months of engineering time.
segments.tr: Cada opción tiene un costo que realmente puedes calcular: enviar por aire un pedido parcial a unos $4–6 por kilogramo frente a unos $0.30 por mar, mantener cuatro semanas extra de inventario de seguridad con un costo de mantenimiento del 20–25% del valor del inventario al año, o calificar a un segundo proveedor en unos pocos meses de trabajo de ingeniería.

segments.src: None of those choices is obvious.
segments.tr: Ninguna de esas decisiones es obvia.

segments.src: But once you've written down the perfect order rate, the fine schedule, TTR versus TTS, and the carrying cost, you're making a business decision instead of a guess.
segments.tr: Pero una vez que has anotado la tasa de pedido perfecto, el calendario de multas, el TTR frente al TTS y el costo de mantenimiento, estás tomando una decisión de negocio en lugar de una suposición.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Resumen en tres líneas

segments.src: 1. Component metrics lie; end-to-end metrics like perfect order rate and cash-to-cash tell the truth, because errors multiply rather than average.
segments.tr: 1. Las métricas de componentes engañan; las métricas de extremo a extremo, como la tasa de pedido perfecto y el ciclo cash-to-cash, dicen la verdad, porque los errores se multiplican en lugar de promediarse.

segments.src: 2. SCOR provides shared language and forces the trade-off — reliability, responsiveness, agility, cost, and assets cannot all be maximized at once.
segments.tr: 2. SCOR proporciona un lenguaje común y obliga a asumir la compensación: confiabilidad, capacidad de respuesta, agilidad, costo y activos no pueden maximizarse todos a la vez.

segments.src: 3. Manage risk by comparing time-to-recover with time-to-survive rather than guessing probabilities, and treat emissions per ton-mile as a real KPI alongside cost.
segments.tr: 3. Gestiona el riesgo comparando el tiempo de recuperación con el tiempo de supervivencia en lugar de adivinar probabilidades, y trata las emisiones por tonelada-milla como un KPI real junto al costo.

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Términos de hoy

segments.src: - **Perfect Order Rate** — Share of orders delivered on time, complete, undamaged, and correctly documented; the four rates multiply.
segments.tr: - **Tasa de pedido perfecto** — Proporción de pedidos entregados a tiempo, completos, sin daños y con documentación correcta; las cuatro tasas se multiplican.

segments.src: - **SCOR** — The Supply Chain Operations Reference model, an ASCM-maintained standard for describing supply chain processes and scoring their performance.
segments.tr: - **SCOR** — El modelo Supply Chain Operations Reference, un estándar mantenido por ASCM para describir los procesos de la cadena de suministro y evaluar su desempeño.

segments.src: - **Cash-to-Cash Cycle Time** — Days of working capital tied up between paying suppliers and collecting from customers.
segments.tr: - **Tiempo de ciclo cash-to-cash** — Días de capital de trabajo inmovilizado entre el pago a proveedores y el cobro a clientes.

segments.src: - **TTR / TTS** — Time to Recover from a disrupted node versus Time to Survive on existing inventory; exposure exists when TTR is longer than TTS.
segments.tr: - **TTR / TTS** — Tiempo para recuperarse de un nodo interrumpido frente a tiempo para sobrevivir con el inventario existente; existe exposición cuando el TTR es mayor que el TTS.

segments.src: - **Scope 3 Emissions** — Indirect emissions from purchased goods and outsourced transportation, typically the largest share of a shipper's carbon footprint.
segments.tr: - **Emisiones de Alcance 3** — Emisiones indirectas de los bienes comprados y del transporte tercerizado, normalmente la mayor parte de la huella de carbono de un remitente.

segments.src: > A supply chain you can't measure is one you can't defend — this lesson covers the KPIs that matter, the SCOR framework that organizes them, how to price risk before it hits, and why emissions are becoming a logistics metric too.
segments.tr: > سلسلة التوريد التي لا يمكنك قياسها لا يمكنك الدفاع عنها — يغطي هذا الدرس مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية المهمة، وإطار SCOR الذي ينظّمها، وكيفية تسعير المخاطر قبل أن تقع، ولماذا أصبحت الانبعاثات مقياساً لوجستياً أيضاً.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## درس اليوم

segments.src: Every warehouse manager will tell you things are "running fine."
segments.tr: كل مدير مستودع سيخبرك بأن الأمور "تسير بشكل جيد".

segments.src: The job of performance measurement is to replace that sentence with a number.
segments.tr: مهمة قياس الأداء هي استبدال تلك الجملة برقم.

segments.src: **Start with KPIs — but the right ones.** The single most useful logistics metric is the **perfect order rate**: the share of orders delivered on time, complete, undamaged, and with correct paperwork.
segments.tr: **ابدأ بمؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية — ولكن الصحيحة منها.** أكثر المقاييس اللوجستية فائدة هو **معدل الطلب المثالي**: نسبة الطلبات التي تُسلَّم في الوقت المحدد، وكاملة، وغير تالفة، ومع أوراق صحيحة.

segments.tr: وهو قاسٍ لأنه يتضاعف:

segments.tr: Perfect order rate = on-time % x complete % x damage-free % x correct-docs %

segments.src: Four "excellent" 98% scores produce a 92% perfect order rate.
segments.tr: أربع درجات «ممتازة» بنسبة 98% تنتج معدل طلب مثالي بنسبة 92%.

segments.tr: هذه الفجوة بين المقاييس الجزئية والمقاييس الشاملة من البداية إلى النهاية هي المكان الذي تكمن فيه معظم شكاوى سلسلة التوريد.

segments.src: Other core measures:
segments.tr: مقاييس أساسية أخرى:

segments.src: - **Order fulfillment cycle time** — order placed to customer receipt.
segments.tr: - **وقت دورة تنفيذ الطلب** — من تقديم الطلب حتى استلام العميل له.

segments.src: - **Cash-to-cash cycle time** — days between paying your supplier and getting paid by your customer: `inventory days + receivable days - payable days`.
segments.tr: - **وقت دورة النقد من النقد** — عدد الأيام بين دفعك للمورد وتحصيلك من عميلك: `أيام المخزون + أيام المستحقات المدينة - أيام المستحقات الدائنة`.

segments.tr: - **معدل دوران المخزون** و**أيام التغطية** — مدى كفاءة عمل رأس مالك العامل.

segments.tr: - **تكلفة الخدمة** — إجمالي تكلفة الخدمات اللوجستية لكل طلب، أو لكل وحدة، أو لكل عميل.

segments.tr: زوج أكثر عملية من الأسئلة، اشتهر به ديفيد سيمتشي-ليفي من MIT:

segments.src: - **Time to Recover (TTR):** if this node goes dark, how long until supply is restored?

segments.src: If TTR exceeds TTS, you have a real exposure, whatever the probability.

segments.tr: **الاستدامة باتت مؤشراً لوجستياً، لا بياناً صحفياً.** النقل والبضائع المشتراة تندرج ضمن انبعاثات **النطاق 3**، التي تفوق بالنسبة لمعظم تجار التجزئة والمصنّعين منشآتهم وأساطيلهم الخاصة بكثير.

segments.src: The operational levers are the same ones that cut cost: raise trailer load factor, cut **empty miles**, shift long hauls from truck to intermodal rail, right-size packaging, consolidate LTL shipments into full truckloads.
segments.tr: الروافع التشغيلية هي نفسها التي تخفض التكلفة: رفع معامل تحميل المقطورة، وتقليص **الأميال الفارغة**، ونقل المسافات الطويلة من الشاحنات إلى السكك الحديدية متعددة الوسائط، وتحجيم التغليف بشكل مناسب، وتجميع شحنات LTL في حمولات شاحنة كاملة.

segments.src: Emissions per ton-mile is the metric; the EPA's SmartWay program is the common US benchmark for carrier performance.
segments.tr: الانبعاثات لكل طن-ميل هي المقياس؛ وبرنامج SmartWay التابع لوكالة حماية البيئة الأمريكية هو المعيار الشائع في الولايات المتحدة لأداء الناقلين.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## في الحياة اليومية

segments.src: Say you run a Columbus, Ohio distributor selling houseware to a big-box retailer.
segments.tr: لنفترض أنك تدير موزعاً في كولومبوس بولاية أوهايو يبيع أدوات منزلية لسلسلة تجزئة كبرى.

segments.src: Your goods move from a supplier in Vietnam, through the Port of Long Beach, by rail to Chicago, then by truck to your DC.
segments.tr: تنتقل بضائعك من مورد في فيتنام، عبر ميناء لونغ بيتش، بالسكك الحديدية إلى شيكاغو، ثم بالشاحنة إلى مركز التوزيع الخاص بك.

segments.src: Your internal dashboard looks great: 97% on-time from the DC, 99% pick accuracy.
segments.tr: لوحة قياساتك الداخلية تبدو رائعة: 97% تسليم في الموعد من مركز التوزيع، و99% دقة في الالتقاط.

segments.src: Then your retail customer's scorecard arrives.
segments.tr: ثم تصل بطاقة أداء عميل التجزئة لديك.

segments.src: Large chains run **OTIF (on-time, in-full)** programs and charge suppliers for misses — Walmart's has assessed fees of roughly 3% of the value of noncompliant goods.
segments.tr: تدير السلاسل الكبرى برامج **OTIF (في الوقت المحدد وكاملة)** وتفرض على الموردين رسوماً عند الإخفاقات — فقد فرض برنامج وولمارت رسوماً تقارب 3% من قيمة البضائع غير المطابقة.

segments.src: On $8 million of annual shipments to that account, a 10% miss rate is about $24,000 in fines, plus expedited freight to chase the shortfalls, plus a worse position in next year's negotiation.
segments.tr: على شحنات سنوية بقيمة 8 ملايين دولار لهذا الحساب، فإن معدل إخفاق بنسبة 10% يعني غرامات تقارب 24,000 دولار، إضافة إلى شحن معجّل لتعويض النقص، وموقف أسوأ في مفاوضات العام المقبل.

segments.src: Then the port slows down for three weeks.
segments.tr: ثم يتباطأ الميناء لمدة ثلاثة أسابيع.

segments.src: You dig into your risk register and find the honest numbers: TTR for that ocean lane is 5 weeks; your TTS on current inventory is 3 weeks.
segments.tr: تغوص في سجل المخاطر وتجد الأرقام الصادقة: TTR لذلك المسار البحري 5 أسابيع؛ وTTS لديك على المخزون الحالي 3 أسابيع.

segments.src: Two weeks exposed.
segments.tr: أسبوعان مكشوفان.

segments.src: The options each carry a price you can actually compute — air freight a partial order at maybe $4–6 per kilogram versus roughly $0.30 by ocean, hold four extra weeks of safety stock at a carrying cost of 20–25% of inventory value per year, or qualify a second supplier at a few months of engineering time.
segments.tr: لكل خيار سعر يمكنك حسابه فعلياً — الشحن الجوي لجزء من الطلب بحوالي 4–6 دولارات للكيلوغرام مقابل نحو 0.30 دولار بحراً، أو الاحتفاظ بأربعة أسابيع إضافية من مخزون الأمان بتكلفة حيازة 20–25% من قيمة المخزون سنوياً، أو تأهيل مورد ثانٍ باستغراق بضعة أشهر من الوقت الهندسي.

segments.src: None of those choices is obvious.
segments.tr: لا يوجد أي من هذه الخيارات واضحاً.

segments.src: But once you've written down the perfect order rate, the fine schedule, TTR versus TTS, and the carrying cost, you're making a business decision instead of a guess.
segments.tr: لكن بمجرد أن تدوّن معدل الطلب المثالي، وجدول الغرامات، وTTR مقابل TTS، وتكلفة الحيازة، فأنت تتخذ قراراً تجارياً بدلاً من التخمين.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## ملخص من ثلاثة أسطر

segments.src: 1. Component metrics lie; end-to-end metrics like perfect order rate and cash-to-cash tell the truth, because errors multiply rather than average.
segments.tr: 1. المقاييس الجزئية تضلّل؛ أما المقاييس الشاملة مثل معدل الطلب المثالي ودورة النقد من النقد فتقول الحقيقة، لأن الأخطاء تتضاعف بدلاً من أن تتوسّط.

segments.src: 2. SCOR provides shared language and forces the trade-off — reliability, responsiveness, agility, cost, and assets cannot all be maximized at once.
segments.tr: 2. يوفر SCOR لغةً مشتركة ويفرض المفاضلة — فالموثوقية والاستجابة والمرونة والتكلفة والأصول لا يمكن تعظيمها جميعاً في آنٍ واحد.

segments.src: 3. Manage risk by comparing time-to-recover with time-to-survive rather than guessing probabilities, and treat emissions per ton-mile as a real KPI alongside cost.
segments.tr: 3. أدِر المخاطر بمقارنة زمن الاستعادة بزمن البقاء بدلاً من تخمين الاحتمالات، وعامل الانبعاثات لكل طن-ميل كمؤشر حقيقي إلى جانب التكلفة.

segments.tr: ## ✅ اختبار ذاتي

segments.tr: A) أيام المخزون + أيام المستحقات المدينة − أيام المستحقات الدائنة

segments.tr: B) أيام المستحقات المدينة + أيام المستحقات الدائنة − أيام المخزون

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 مصطلحات اليوم

segments.src: - **Perfect Order Rate** — Share of orders delivered on time, complete, undamaged, and correctly documented; the four rates multiply.
segments.tr: - **معدل الطلب المثالي (Perfect Order Rate)** — نسبة الطلبات المُسلَّمة في الوقت المحدد وكاملة وغير تالفة وموثقة بشكل صحيح؛ المعدلات الأربعة تتضاعف.

segments.src: - **SCOR** — The Supply Chain Operations Reference model, an ASCM-maintained standard for describing supply chain processes and scoring their performance.
segments.tr: - **SCOR** — نموذج مرجع عمليات سلسلة التوريد، وهو معيار تحافظ عليه ASCM لوصف عمليات سلسلة التوريد وتقييم أدائها.

segments.src: - **Cash-to-Cash Cycle Time** — Days of working capital tied up between paying suppliers and collecting from customers.
segments.tr: - **وقت دورة النقد من النقد (Cash-to-Cash Cycle Time)** — الأيام التي يبقى فيها رأس المال العامل مرتبطاً بين دفع الموردين وتحصيل المستحقات من العملاء.

segments.src: - **TTR / TTS** — Time to Recover from a disrupted node versus Time to Survive on existing inventory; exposure exists when TTR is longer than TTS.
segments.tr: - **TTR / TTS** — زمن الاستعادة من عقدة متعطلة مقابل زمن البقاء على المخزون الحالي؛ يوجد التعرّض للخطر عندما يكون TTR أطول من TTS.

segments.src: - **Scope 3 Emissions** — Indirect emissions from purchased goods and outsourced transportation, typically the largest share of a shipper's carbon footprint.
segments.tr: - **انبعاثات النطاق 3 (Scope 3 Emissions)** — الانبعاثات غير المباشرة الناتجة عن البضائع المشتراة والنقل المتعاقد عليه، وتمثل عادةً الحصة الأكبر من البصمة الكربونية للشاحن.

segments.src: Rank by impact as well as likelihood; low-probability, high-impact events are exactly the ones that require a survival plan, since probability estimates for rare events are unreliable.

fr.title: [Logistics 101 #14] Le piège des 98 % : pourquoi « presque à l'heure » vous coûte réellement de l'argent

segments.src: > A supply chain you can't measure is one you can't defend — this lesson covers the KPIs that matter, the SCOR framework that organizes them, how to price risk before it hits, and why emissions are becoming a logistics metric too.
segments.tr: > Une chaîne d'approvisionnement que vous ne pouvez pas mesurer est une chaîne que vous ne pouvez pas défendre. Cette leçon couvre les KPI qui comptent, le modèle SCOR qui les organise, la manière de chiffrer le risque avant qu'il ne frappe, et pourquoi les émissions deviennent elles aussi un indicateur logistique.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Concept du jour

segments.src: Every warehouse manager will tell you things are "running fine."
segments.tr: Chaque responsable d'entrepôt vous dira que tout « tourne bien ».

segments.src: The job of performance measurement is to replace that sentence with a number.
segments.tr: Le rôle de la mesure de performance est de remplacer cette phrase par un chiffre.

segments.src: **Start with KPIs — but the right ones.** The single most useful logistics metric is the **perfect order rate**: the share of orders delivered on time, complete, undamaged, and with correct paperwork.
segments.tr: **Commencez par les KPI, mais les bons.** L'indicateur logistique le plus utile est le **taux de commande parfaite** : la part des commandes livrées à l'heure, complètes, intactes et avec des documents corrects.

segments.src: It's brutal because it multiplies:
segments.tr: Il est impitoyable, car il se multiplie :

segments.src: Perfect order rate = on-time % x complete % x damage-free % x correct-docs %
segments.tr: Perfect order rate = on-time % x complete % x damage-free % x correct-docs %

segments.src: Four "excellent" 98% scores produce a 92% perfect order rate.
segments.tr: Quatre scores « excellents » de 98 % donnent un taux de commande parfaite de 92 %.

segments.src: Eight orders in every hundred go wrong somewhere.
segments.tr: Huit commandes sur cent tournent mal quelque part.

segments.src: That gap between component metrics and end-to-end metrics is where most supply chain complaints live.
segments.tr: Cet écart entre les indicateurs par composant et les indicateurs de bout en bout est là où se concentrent la plupart des réclamations sur la chaîne d'approvisionnement.

segments.src: Other core measures:
segments.tr: Autres mesures essentielles :

segments.src: - **Order fulfillment cycle time** — order placed to customer receipt.
segments.tr: - **Délai de cycle de traitement de commande** : de la passation de la commande à la réception par le client.

segments.src: - **Cash-to-cash cycle time** — days between paying your supplier and getting paid by your customer: `inventory days + receivable days - payable days`.
segments.tr: - **Cycle de trésorerie (cash-to-cash)** : nombre de jours entre le paiement de votre fournisseur et l'encaissement auprès de votre client, soit `jours de stock + jours de créances − jours de dettes fournisseurs`.

segments.src: - **Inventory turns** and **days of supply** — how hard your working capital is working.
segments.tr: - **Rotation des stocks** et **jours de couverture** : le degré d'efficacité avec lequel votre fonds de roulement travaille.

segments.src: - **Cost to serve** — total logistics cost per order, per unit, or per customer.
segments.tr: - **Coût de service** : coût logistique total par commande, par unité ou par client.

segments.src: **SCOR gives these a home.** The Supply Chain Operations Reference model, maintained by ASCM, is the industry's standard vocabulary.
segments.tr: **SCOR leur donne un cadre.** Le modèle Supply Chain Operations Reference, maintenu par l'ASCM, est le vocabulaire standard du secteur.

segments.src: Classic SCOR organizes a supply chain into six process areas — Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, Return, and Enable — and scores them on five attributes: reliability, responsiveness, agility, cost, and asset management efficiency.
segments.tr: Le SCOR classique organise une chaîne d'approvisionnement en six domaines de processus (Planifier, Approvisionner, Produire, Livrer, Retourner et Soutenir) et les évalue selon cinq attributs : fiabilité, réactivité, agilité, coût et efficacité de la gestion des actifs.

segments.src: The current digital revision (SCOR DS) renames and regroups those processes and folds in environmental and social measures alongside the economic ones.
segments.tr: La révision numérique actuelle (SCOR DS) renomme et regroupe ces processus et intègre des mesures environnementales et sociales à côté des mesures économiques.

segments.src: The details shift between versions; the useful idea doesn't.
segments.tr: Les détails changent d'une version à l'autre, mais l'idée utile, elle, ne change pas.

segments.src: SCOR forces you to say *which attribute* you're optimizing, because you cannot maximize all five.
segments.tr: SCOR vous oblige à dire *quel attribut* vous optimisez, car vous ne pouvez pas maximiser les cinq.

segments.src: Faster response usually costs more.
segments.tr: Une réponse plus rapide coûte généralement plus cher.

segments.src: Lower cost usually means less agility.
segments.tr: Un coût plus bas signifie généralement moins d'agilité.

segments.src: Pick, then measure.
segments.tr: Choisissez, puis mesurez.

segments.src: **Risk management is measurement pointed at the future.** The standard move is a risk register: list what could break, score each item on **likelihood** and **impact**, and multiply to rank.
segments.tr: **La gestion des risques, c'est la mesure tournée vers l'avenir.** Le geste standard est un registre des risques : lister ce qui pourrait casser, noter chaque élément selon la **probabilité** et l'**impact**, puis multiplier pour classer.

segments.src: But logistics risk has a twist — the worst events are the low-probability ones, so probability estimates are close to worthless.
segments.tr: Mais le risque logistique a une particularité : les événements les plus graves sont ceux de faible probabilité, si bien que les estimations de probabilité valent presque rien.

segments.src: A more practical pair of questions, popularized by MIT's David Simchi-Levi:
segments.tr: Une paire de questions plus pratique, popularisée par David Simchi-Levi du MIT :

segments.src: - **Time to Recover (TTR):** if this node goes dark, how long until supply is restored?
segments.tr: - **Temps de rétablissement (TTR) :** si ce nœud tombe en panne, combien de temps faudra-t-il pour rétablir l'approvisionnement ?

segments.src: - **Time to Survive (TTS):** how long can we keep serving customers on inventory and alternatives?
segments.tr: - **Temps de survie (TTS) :** combien de temps pouvons-nous continuer à servir les clients avec les stocks et les alternatives disponibles ?

segments.src: If TTR exceeds TTS, you have a real exposure, whatever the probability.
segments.tr: Si le TTR dépasse le TTS, vous avez une exposition réelle, quelle que soit la probabilité.

segments.src: The fixes are familiar: dual sourcing, safety stock at the right node, qualified backup carriers, postponement (finish the product late, closer to demand), and visibility into tier-2 and tier-3 suppliers — because the plant that shuts down is usually one your buyer has never heard of.
segments.tr: Les solutions sont familières : double sourcing, stock de sécurité au bon nœud, transporteurs de secours qualifiés, report de la différenciation (finaliser le produit tard, au plus près de la demande) et visibilité sur les fournisseurs de rang 2 et 3, car l'usine qui s'arrête est généralement une usine dont votre acheteur n'a jamais entendu parler.

segments.src: **Sustainability is now a logistics KPI, not a press release.** Transportation and purchased goods sit in **Scope 3** emissions, which for most retailers and manufacturers dwarf their own facilities and fleet.
segments.tr: **La durabilité est désormais un KPI logistique, pas un communiqué de presse.** Le transport et les marchandises achetées figurent dans les émissions de **Scope 3**, qui, pour la plupart des distributeurs et industriels, dépassent largement celles de leurs propres installations et de leur flotte.

segments.src: The operational levers are the same ones that cut cost: raise trailer load factor, cut **empty miles**, shift long hauls from truck to intermodal rail, right-size packaging, consolidate LTL shipments into full truckloads.
segments.tr: Les leviers opérationnels sont les mêmes que ceux qui réduisent les coûts : augmenter le taux de remplissage des remorques, réduire les **trajets à vide**, transférer les longs trajets de la route vers le ferroviaire intermodal, dimensionner correctement les emballages, regrouper les envois LTL en chargements complets.

segments.src: Emissions per ton-mile is the metric; the EPA's SmartWay program is the common US benchmark for carrier performance.
segments.tr: L'indicateur de référence est les émissions par tonne-mile ; le programme SmartWay de l'EPA est le benchmark américain courant pour la performance des transporteurs.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dans la vie quotidienne

segments.src: Say you run a Columbus, Ohio distributor selling houseware to a big-box retailer.
segments.tr: Imaginez que vous dirigiez un distributeur d'articles de maison à Columbus, dans l'Ohio, qui vend à une grande enseigne.

segments.src: Your goods move from a supplier in Vietnam, through the Port of Long Beach, by rail to Chicago, then by truck to your DC.
segments.tr: Vos marchandises partent d'un fournisseur au Vietnam, transitent par le port de Long Beach, puis sont acheminées par train jusqu'à Chicago, et enfin par camion jusqu'à votre entrepôt.

segments.src: Your internal dashboard looks great: 97% on-time from the DC, 99% pick accuracy.
segments.tr: Votre tableau de bord interne est excellent : 97 % de livraisons à l'heure depuis l'entrepôt, 99 % de précision de préparation.

segments.src: Then your retail customer's scorecard arrives.
segments.tr: Puis arrive la fiche d'évaluation de votre client de la distribution.

segments.src: Large chains run **OTIF (on-time, in-full)** programs and charge suppliers for misses — Walmart's has assessed fees of roughly 3% of the value of noncompliant goods.
segments.tr: Les grandes enseignes gèrent des programmes **OTIF (à l'heure, en complet)** et facturent les manquements aux fournisseurs. Celui de Walmart a prélevé des pénalités d'environ 3 % de la valeur des marchandises non conformes.

segments.src: On $8 million of annual shipments to that account, a 10% miss rate is about $24,000 in fines, plus expedited freight to chase the shortfalls, plus a worse position in next year's negotiation.
segments.tr: Sur 8 millions de dollars d'expéditions annuelles vers ce compte, un taux de manquement de 10 % représente environ 24 000 $ d'amendes, plus le fret express pour rattraper les manques, plus une position plus faible lors de la négociation de l'année suivante.

segments.src: Then the port slows down for three weeks.
segments.tr: Puis le port ralentit pendant trois semaines.

segments.src: You dig into your risk register and find the honest numbers: TTR for that ocean lane is 5 weeks; your TTS on current inventory is 3 weeks.
segments.tr: Vous examinez votre registre des risques et trouvez les chiffres honnêtes : le TTR pour cette ligne maritime est de 5 semaines, et votre TTS sur les stocks actuels est de 3 semaines.

segments.src: Two weeks exposed.
segments.tr: Deux semaines d'exposition.

segments.src: The options each carry a price you can actually compute — air freight a partial order at maybe $4–6 per kilogram versus roughly $0.30 by ocean, hold four extra weeks of safety stock at a carrying cost of 20–25% of inventory value per year, or qualify a second supplier at a few months of engineering time.
segments.tr: Chaque option a un coût que vous pouvez réellement calculer : expédier par avion une partie de la commande à environ 4 à 6 $ le kilo, contre environ 0,30 $ par voie maritime ; conserver quatre semaines supplémentaires de stock de sécurité, avec un coût de possession de 20 à 25 % de la valeur du stock par an ; ou qualifier un second fournisseur en quelques mois d'ingénierie.

segments.src: None of those choices is obvious.
segments.tr: Aucun de ces choix n'est évident.

segments.src: But once you've written down the perfect order rate, the fine schedule, TTR versus TTS, and the carrying cost, you're making a business decision instead of a guess.
segments.tr: Mais une fois que vous avez consigné le taux de commande parfaite, le barème des pénalités, le TTR face au TTS et le coût de possession, vous prenez une décision d'entreprise au lieu d'une supposition.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Récapitulatif en trois points

segments.src: 1. Component metrics lie; end-to-end metrics like perfect order rate and cash-to-cash tell the truth, because errors multiply rather than average.
segments.tr: 1. Les indicateurs par composant trompent ; les indicateurs de bout en bout comme le taux de commande parfaite et le cycle de trésorerie disent la vérité, car les erreurs se multiplient au lieu de se moyenner.

segments.src: 2. SCOR provides shared language and forces the trade-off — reliability, responsiveness, agility, cost, and assets cannot all be maximized at once.
segments.tr: 2. SCOR fournit un langage commun et impose l'arbitrage : fiabilité, réactivité, agilité, coût et actifs ne peuvent pas être tous maximisés en même temps.

segments.src: 3. Manage risk by comparing time-to-recover with time-to-survive rather than guessing probabilities, and treat emissions per ton-mile as a real KPI alongside cost.
segments.tr: 3. Gérez le risque en comparant le temps de rétablissement au temps de survie plutôt qu'en devinant des probabilités, et traitez les émissions par tonne-mile comme un KPI à part entière, au même titre que le coût.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz
