pt.title: [Logística 101 #14] A armadilha dos 98%: por que "quase no prazo" custa dinheiro de verdade

segments.src: > A supply chain you can't measure is one you can't defend — this lesson covers the KPIs that matter, the SCOR framework that organizes them, how to price risk before it hits, and why emissions are becoming a logistics metric too.
segments.tr: > Uma cadeia de suprimentos que você não consegue medir é uma que você não consegue defender. Esta lição aborda os KPIs que importam, o framework SCOR que os organiza, como precificar o risco antes que ele se concretize e por que as emissões também estão se tornando uma métrica de logística.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Conceito de Hoje

segments.src: Every warehouse manager will tell you things are "running fine."
segments.tr: Todo gerente de armazém vai dizer que as coisas estão "funcionando bem".

segments.src: The job of performance measurement is to replace that sentence with a number.
segments.tr: A função da medição de desempenho é substituir essa frase por um número.

segments.src: **Start with KPIs — but the right ones.** The single most useful logistics metric is the **perfect order rate**: the share of orders delivered on time, complete, undamaged, and with correct paperwork.
segments.tr: **Comece pelos KPIs, mas pelos certos.** A métrica de logística mais útil é a **taxa de pedido perfeito**: a proporção de pedidos entregues no prazo, completos, sem avarias e com a documentação correta.

segments.src: It's brutal because it multiplies:
segments.tr: Ela é implacável porque multiplica:

segments.src: Perfect order rate = on-time % x complete % x damage-free % x correct-docs %
segments.tr: Perfect order rate = on-time % x complete % x damage-free % x correct-docs %

segments.src: Four "excellent" 98% scores produce a 92% perfect order rate.
segments.tr: Quatro índices "excelentes" de 98% produzem uma taxa de pedido perfeito de 92%.

segments.src: Eight orders in every hundred go wrong somewhere.
segments.tr: Oito pedidos em cada cem dão errado em algum ponto.

segments.src: That gap between component metrics and end-to-end metrics is where most supply chain complaints live.
segments.tr: Essa diferença entre métricas de componentes e métricas de ponta a ponta é onde se concentra a maioria das reclamações sobre a cadeia de suprimentos.

segments.src: Other core measures:
segments.tr: Outras medidas essenciais:

segments.src: - **Order fulfillment cycle time** — order placed to customer receipt.
segments.tr: - **Tempo de ciclo do atendimento do pedido**: do momento em que o pedido é feito até o recebimento pelo cliente.

segments.src: - **Cash-to-cash cycle time** — days between paying your supplier and getting paid by your customer: `inventory days + receivable days - payable days`.
segments.tr: - **Ciclo caixa-a-caixa**: dias entre pagar ao fornecedor e receber do cliente, ou seja, `dias de estoque + dias a receber - dias a pagar`.

segments.src: - **Inventory turns** and **days of supply** — how hard your working capital is working.
segments.tr: - **Giro de estoque** e **dias de cobertura**: o quanto o seu capital de giro está trabalhando.

segments.src: - **Cost to serve** — total logistics cost per order, per unit, or per customer.
segments.tr: - **Custo de atendimento**: custo logístico total por pedido, por unidade ou por cliente.

segments.src: **SCOR gives these a home.** The Supply Chain Operations Reference model, maintained by ASCM, is the industry's standard vocabulary.
segments.tr: **O SCOR dá a elas um lugar.** O Supply Chain Operations Reference model, mantido pela ASCM, é o vocabulário padrão do setor.

segments.src: Classic SCOR organizes a supply chain into six process areas — Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, Return, and Enable — and scores them on five attributes: reliability, responsiveness, agility, cost, and asset management efficiency.
segments.tr: O SCOR clássico organiza uma cadeia de suprimentos em seis áreas de processo (Planejar, Originar, Produzir, Entregar, Devolver e Habilitar) e as avalia em cinco atributos: confiabilidade, responsividade, agilidade, custo e eficiência no uso de ativos.

segments.src: The current digital revision (SCOR DS) renames and regroups those processes and folds in environmental and social measures alongside the economic ones.
segments.tr: A revisão digital atual (SCOR DS) renomeia e reagrupa esses processos e incorpora medidas ambientais e sociais junto às econômicas.

segments.src: The details shift between versions; the useful idea doesn't.
segments.tr: Os detalhes mudam entre as versões, mas a ideia útil não muda.

segments.src: SCOR forces you to say *which attribute* you're optimizing, because you cannot maximize all five.
segments.tr: O SCOR obriga você a dizer *qual atributo* está otimizando, porque não é possível maximizar os cinco ao mesmo tempo.

segments.src: Faster response usually costs more.
segments.tr: Responder mais rápido geralmente custa mais.

segments.src: Lower cost usually means less agility.
segments.tr: Custo menor geralmente significa menos agilidade.

segments.src: Pick, then measure.
segments.tr: Escolha e depois meça.

segments.src: **Risk management is measurement pointed at the future.** The standard move is a risk register: list what could break, score each item on **likelihood** and **impact**, and multiply to rank.
segments.tr: **Gestão de risco é medição voltada para o futuro.** O procedimento padrão é um registro de riscos: liste o que poderia dar errado, avalie cada item em **probabilidade** e **impacto** e multiplique para ordenar.

segments.src: But logistics risk has a twist — the worst events are the low-probability ones, so probability estimates are close to worthless.
segments.tr: Mas o risco logístico tem uma particularidade: os piores eventos são os de baixa probabilidade, então as estimativas de probabilidade são quase inúteis.

segments.src: A more practical pair of questions, popularized by MIT's David Simchi-Levi:
segments.tr: Um par de perguntas mais prático, popularizado por David Simchi-Levi, do MIT:

segments.src: - **Time to Recover (TTR):** if this node goes dark, how long until supply is restored?
segments.tr: - **Tempo para Recuperar (TTR):** se este nó parar, quanto tempo até o fornecimento ser restabelecido?

segments.src: - **Time to Survive (TTS):** how long can we keep serving customers on inventory and alternatives?
segments.tr: - **Tempo para Sobreviver (TTS):** por quanto tempo conseguimos continuar atendendo clientes com o estoque e alternativas disponíveis?

segments.src: If TTR exceeds TTS, you have a real exposure, whatever the probability.
segments.tr: Se o TTR excede o TTS, você tem uma exposição real, independentemente da probabilidade.

segments.src: The fixes are familiar: dual sourcing, safety stock at the right node, qualified backup carriers, postponement (finish the product late, closer to demand), and visibility into tier-2 and tier-3 suppliers — because the plant that shuts down is usually one your buyer has never heard of.
segments.tr: As soluções são conhecidas: dupla fonte de fornecimento, estoque de segurança no nó certo, transportadoras de reserva qualificadas, postergação (finalizar o produto mais tarde, mais perto da demanda) e visibilidade sobre fornecedores de segundo e terceiro níveis, porque a fábrica que para geralmente é uma que o seu comprador nunca ouviu falar.

segments.src: **Sustainability is now a logistics KPI, not a press release.** Transportation and purchased goods sit in **Scope 3** emissions, which for most retailers and manufacturers dwarf their own facilities and fleet.
segments.tr: **A sustentabilidade agora é um KPI de logística, não um comunicado à imprensa.** Transporte e compras de mercadorias entram nas emissões do **Escopo 3**, que, para a maioria dos varejistas e fabricantes, superam em muito as das próprias instalações e frota.

segments.src: The operational levers are the same ones that cut cost: raise trailer load factor, cut **empty miles**, shift long hauls from truck to intermodal rail, right-size packaging, consolidate LTL shipments into full truckloads.
segments.tr: As alavancas operacionais são as mesmas que reduzem custos: aumentar o fator de carga dos caminhões, reduzir **viagens vazias**, transferir longas distâncias do caminhão para o trem intermodal, dimensionar corretamente as embalagens e consolidar remessas fracionadas (LTL) em cargas completas (FTL).

segments.src: Emissions per ton-mile is the metric; the EPA's SmartWay program is the common US benchmark for carrier performance.
segments.tr: Emissões por tonelada-milha são a métrica; o programa SmartWay da EPA é o principal benchmark dos EUA para o desempenho de transportadoras.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## No Dia a Dia

segments.src: Say you run a Columbus, Ohio distributor selling houseware to a big-box retailer.
segments.tr: Imagine que você administra um distribuidor de utensílios domésticos em Columbus, Ohio, que vende para uma grande rede de varejo.

segments.src: Your goods move from a supplier in Vietnam, through the Port of Long Beach, by rail to Chicago, then by truck to your DC.
segments.tr: Suas mercadorias saem de um fornecedor no Vietnã, passam pelo Porto de Long Beach, seguem de trem até Chicago e depois de caminhão até o seu centro de distribuição.

segments.src: Your internal dashboard looks great: 97% on-time from the DC, 99% pick accuracy.
segments.tr: Seu painel interno está ótimo: 97% de entregas no prazo saindo do centro de distribuição e 99% de precisão na separação.

segments.src: Then your retail customer's scorecard arrives.
segments.tr: Então chega o scorecard do seu cliente varejista.

segments.src: Large chains run **OTIF (on-time, in-full)** programs and charge suppliers for misses — Walmart's has assessed fees of roughly 3% of the value of noncompliant goods.
segments.tr: Grandes redes operam programas **OTIF (on-time, in-full, ou seja, no prazo e completo)** e cobram dos fornecedores pelas falhas. O programa da Walmart já aplicou multas de cerca de 3% do valor das mercadorias não conformes.

segments.src: On $8 million of annual shipments to that account, a 10% miss rate is about $24,000 in fines, plus expedited freight to chase the shortfalls, plus a worse position in next year's negotiation.
segments.tr: Com $ 8 milhões em remessas anuais para essa conta, uma taxa de falha de 10% representa cerca de $ 24.000 em multas, mais o frete expresso para correr atrás das faltas, mais uma posição pior na negociação do ano seguinte.

segments.src: Then the port slows down for three weeks.
segments.tr: Depois, o porto desacelera por três semanas.

segments.src: You dig into your risk register and find the honest numbers: TTR for that ocean lane is 5 weeks; your TTS on current inventory is 3 weeks.
segments.tr: Você consulta o registro de riscos e encontra os números reais: o TTR dessa rota marítima é de 5 semanas, e o seu TTS com o estoque atual é de 3 semanas.

segments.src: Two weeks exposed.
segments.tr: Duas semanas de exposição.

segments.src: The options each carry a price you can actually compute — air freight a partial order at maybe $4–6 per kilogram versus roughly $0.30 by ocean, hold four extra weeks of safety stock at a carrying cost of 20–25% of inventory value per year, or qualify a second supplier at a few months of engineering time.
segments.tr: Cada opção tem um custo que você consegue calcular de fato: frete aéreo de parte do pedido a algo como $4–6 por quilo, contra cerca de $0,30 por via marítima; manter quatro semanas extras de estoque de segurança, com custo de manutenção de 20–25% do valor do estoque por ano; ou qualificar um segundo fornecedor, o que leva alguns meses de trabalho de engenharia.

segments.src: None of those choices is obvious.
segments.tr: Nenhuma dessas escolhas é óbvia.

segments.src: But once you've written down the perfect order rate, the fine schedule, TTR versus TTS, and the carrying cost, you're making a business decision instead of a guess.
segments.tr: Mas, depois de registrar a taxa de pedido perfeito, a tabela de multas, o TTR versus o TTS e o custo de manutenção, você está tomando uma decisão de negócio em vez de um palpite.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Resumo em Três Linhas

segments.src: 1. Component metrics lie; end-to-end metrics like perfect order rate and cash-to-cash tell the truth, because errors multiply rather than average.
segments.tr: 1. Métricas de componentes enganam. Métricas de ponta a ponta, como a taxa de pedido perfeito e o caixa-a-caixa, dizem a verdade, porque os erros se multiplicam em vez de se fazer média.

segments.src: 2. SCOR provides shared language and forces the trade-off — reliability, responsiveness, agility, cost, and assets cannot all be maximized at once.
segments.tr: 2. O SCOR oferece uma linguagem comum e torna o trade-off explícito: confiabilidade, responsividade, agilidade, custo e ativos não podem ser maximizados ao mesmo tempo.

segments.src: 3. Manage risk by comparing time-to-recover with time-to-survive rather than guessing probabilities, and treat emissions per ton-mile as a real KPI alongside cost.
segments.tr: 3. Gerencie o risco comparando o tempo para recuperar com o tempo para sobreviver, em vez de chutar probabilidades, e trate as emissões por tonelada-milha como um KPI real, ao lado do custo.

in.title: [Logistics 101 #14] Jebakan 98%: Mengapa "Hampir Tepat Waktu" Tetap Merugikan Anda Secara Nyata

segments.src: > A supply chain you can't measure is one you can't defend — this lesson covers the KPIs that matter, the SCOR framework that organizes them, how to price risk before it hits, and why emissions are becoming a logistics metric too.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Konsep Hari Ini

segments.src: Every warehouse manager will tell you things are "running fine."
segments.tr: Setiap manajer gudang akan mengatakan bahwa semuanya "berjalan baik-baik saja".

segments.tr: Tugas pengukuran kinerja adalah mengganti kalimat itu dengan sebuah angka.

segments.src: **Start with KPIs — but the right ones.** The single most useful logistics metric is the **perfect order rate**: the share of orders delivered on time, complete, undamaged, and with correct paperwork.
segments.tr: **Mulailah dari KPI, tetapi yang tepat.** Metrik logistik yang paling berguna adalah **tingkat pesanan sempurna (perfect order rate)**: persentase pesanan yang dikirim tepat waktu, lengkap, tidak rusak, dan dengan dokumen yang benar.

segments.src: It's brutal because it multiplies:
segments.tr: Metrik ini sangat ketat karena bersifat perkalian:

segments.src: Perfect order rate = on-time % x complete % x damage-free % x correct-docs %
segments.tr: Perfect order rate = on-time % x complete % x damage-free % x correct-docs %

segments.src: Four "excellent" 98% scores produce a 92% perfect order rate.
segments.tr: Empat skor "sangat baik" sebesar 98% menghasilkan tingkat pesanan sempurna sebesar 92%.

segments.src: Eight orders in every hundred go wrong somewhere.
segments.tr: Delapan dari setiap seratus pesanan mengalami masalah di suatu titik.

segments.src: That gap between component metrics and end-to-end metrics is where most supply chain complaints live.
segments.tr: Kesenjangan antara metrik komponen dan metrik ujung-ke-ujung (end-to-end) inilah tempat sebagian besar keluhan rantai pasokan berasal.

segments.src: Other core measures:
segments.tr: Ukuran inti lainnya:

segments.src: - **Order fulfillment cycle time** — order placed to customer receipt.
segments.tr: - **Waktu siklus pemenuhan pesanan** — dari pesanan dibuat hingga diterima pelanggan.

segments.src: - **Cash-to-cash cycle time** — days between paying your supplier and getting paid by your customer: `inventory days + receivable days - payable days`.
segments.tr: - **Waktu siklus kas-ke-kas (cash-to-cash)** — jumlah hari antara saat Anda membayar pemasok dan saat Anda dibayar pelanggan: `hari persediaan + hari piutang - hari utang`.

segments.src: - **Inventory turns** and **days of supply** — how hard your working capital is working.
segments.tr: - **Perputaran persediaan (inventory turns)** dan **hari persediaan (days of supply)** — seberapa keras modal kerja Anda bekerja.

segments.src: - **Cost to serve** — total logistics cost per order, per unit, or per customer.
segments.tr: - **Biaya layanan (cost to serve)** — total biaya logistik per pesanan, per unit, atau per pelanggan.

segments.src: **SCOR gives these a home.** The Supply Chain Operations Reference model, maintained by ASCM, is the industry's standard vocabulary.
segments.tr: **SCOR memberikan rumah bagi semua ini.** Supply Chain Operations Reference model, yang dikelola oleh ASCM, adalah kosakata standar industri.

segments.src: Classic SCOR organizes a supply chain into six process areas — Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, Return, and Enable — and scores them on five attributes: reliability, responsiveness, agility, cost, and asset management efficiency.
segments.tr: SCOR klasik mengorganisasikan rantai pasokan menjadi enam area proses (Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, Return, dan Enable) dan menilainya berdasarkan lima atribut: keandalan, daya tanggap, kegesitan, biaya, dan efisiensi aset.

segments.src: The current digital revision (SCOR DS) renames and regroups those processes and folds in environmental and social measures alongside the economic ones.
segments.tr: Revisi digital terkini (SCOR DS) mengganti nama dan mengelompokkan ulang proses-proses tersebut serta memasukkan ukuran lingkungan dan sosial bersama ukuran ekonomi.

segments.src: The details shift between versions; the useful idea doesn't.
segments.tr: Detailnya berubah antarversi; gagasan yang berguna tidak.

segments.src: SCOR forces you to say *which attribute* you're optimizing, because you cannot maximize all five.
segments.tr: SCOR memaksa Anda menyebutkan *atribut mana* yang sedang dioptimalkan, karena Anda tidak dapat memaksimalkan kelima atribut sekaligus.

segments.src: Faster response usually costs more.
segments.tr: Respons yang lebih cepat biasanya membutuhkan biaya lebih besar.

segments.src: Lower cost usually means less agility.
segments.tr: Biaya yang lebih rendah biasanya berarti kegesitan yang lebih kecil.

segments.src: Pick, then measure.
segments.tr: Pilih, lalu ukur.

segments.src: **Risk management is measurement pointed at the future.** The standard move is a risk register: list what could break, score each item on **likelihood** and **impact**, and multiply to rank.
segments.tr: **Manajemen risiko adalah pengukuran yang diarahkan ke masa depan.** Langkah standarnya adalah daftar risiko (risk register): catat hal-hal yang bisa rusak, beri skor setiap item berdasarkan **kemungkinan (likelihood)** dan **dampak (impact)**, lalu kalikan untuk mengurutkan.

segments.src: But logistics risk has a twist — the worst events are the low-probability ones, so probability estimates are close to worthless.
segments.tr: Namun risiko logistik memiliki satu hal khusus: peristiwa terburuk justru yang berprobabilitas rendah, sehingga estimasi probabilitas hampir tidak berguna.

segments.src: A more practical pair of questions, popularized by MIT's David Simchi-Levi:
segments.tr: Sepasang pertanyaan yang lebih praktis, dipopulerkan oleh David Simchi-Levi dari MIT:

segments.src: - **Time to Recover (TTR):** if this node goes dark, how long until supply is restored?
segments.tr: - **Time to Recover (TTR):** jika simpul ini mati, berapa lama hingga pasokan pulih?

segments.src: - **Time to Survive (TTS):** how long can we keep serving customers on inventory and alternatives?
segments.tr: - **Time to Survive (TTS):** berapa lama kita bisa tetap melayani pelanggan dengan persediaan dan alternatif yang ada?

segments.src: If TTR exceeds TTS, you have a real exposure, whatever the probability.
segments.tr: Jika TTR melebihi TTS, Anda memiliki paparan risiko yang nyata, berapa pun probabilitasnya.

segments.src: The fixes are familiar: dual sourcing, safety stock at the right node, qualified backup carriers, postponement (finish the product late, closer to demand), and visibility into tier-2 and tier-3 suppliers — because the plant that shuts down is usually one your buyer has never heard of.
segments.tr: Solusinya sudah dikenal: pemasok ganda (dual sourcing), persediaan pengaman di simpul yang tepat, carrier cadangan yang sudah terkualifikasi, postponement (menyelesaikan produk belakangan, lebih dekat dengan permintaan), dan visibilitas ke pemasok tier-2 dan tier-3, karena pabrik yang berhenti beroperasi biasanya adalah pabrik yang belum pernah didengar oleh pembeli Anda.

segments.src: **Sustainability is now a logistics KPI, not a press release.** Transportation and purchased goods sit in **Scope 3** emissions, which for most retailers and manufacturers dwarf their own facilities and fleet.
segments.tr: **Keberlanjutan kini menjadi KPI logistik, bukan sekadar siaran pers.** Transportasi dan barang yang dibeli termasuk emisi **Scope 3**, yang bagi sebagian besar peritel dan produsen jauh melampaui emisi dari fasilitas dan armada mereka sendiri.

segments.src: The operational levers are the same ones that cut cost: raise trailer load factor, cut **empty miles**, shift long hauls from truck to intermodal rail, right-size packaging, consolidate LTL shipments into full truckloads.
segments.tr: Tuas operasionalnya sama dengan yang memangkas biaya: meningkatkan faktor muat trailer, memangkas **empty miles** (perjalanan kosong), memindahkan rute jarak jauh dari truk ke kereta intermodal, menyesuaikan ukuran kemasan, dan menggabungkan pengiriman LTL menjadi truckload penuh.

segments.src: Emissions per ton-mile is the metric; the EPA's SmartWay program is the common US benchmark for carrier performance.
segments.tr: Emisi per ton-mil adalah metriknya; program SmartWay dari EPA adalah tolok ukur umum di AS untuk kinerja carrier.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari

segments.src: Say you run a Columbus, Ohio distributor selling houseware to a big-box retailer.
segments.tr: Misalkan Anda menjalankan distributor di Columbus, Ohio yang menjual perlengkapan rumah tangga ke peritel besar.

segments.src: Your goods move from a supplier in Vietnam, through the Port of Long Beach, by rail to Chicago, then by truck to your DC.
segments.tr: Barang Anda bergerak dari pemasok di Vietnam, melalui Pelabuhan Long Beach, dengan kereta ke Chicago, lalu dengan truk ke DC (distribution center) Anda.

segments.src: Your internal dashboard looks great: 97% on-time from the DC, 99% pick accuracy.
segments.tr: Dasbor internal Anda terlihat sangat bagus: 97% tepat waktu dari DC, 99% akurasi pengambilan barang.

segments.src: Then your retail customer's scorecard arrives.
segments.tr: Kemudian kartu skor pelanggan ritel Anda tiba.

segments.src: Large chains run **OTIF (on-time, in-full)** programs and charge suppliers for misses — Walmart's has assessed fees of roughly 3% of the value of noncompliant goods.
segments.tr: Rantai besar menjalankan program **OTIF (on-time, in-full)** dan membebankan denda kepada pemasok atas setiap pelanggaran. Program Walmart, misalnya, tercatat mengenakan denda sekitar 3% dari nilai barang yang tidak sesuai.

segments.src: On $8 million of annual shipments to that account, a 10% miss rate is about $24,000 in fines, plus expedited freight to chase the shortfalls, plus a worse position in next year's negotiation.
segments.tr: Dengan pengiriman tahunan senilai $8 juta ke akun tersebut, tingkat pelanggaran 10% berarti sekitar $24.000 denda, ditambah biaya freight ekspres untuk mengejar kekurangan, dan posisi yang lebih lemah dalam negosiasi tahun depan.

segments.src: Then the port slows down for three weeks.
segments.tr: Lalu pelabuhan melambat selama tiga minggu.

segments.src: You dig into your risk register and find the honest numbers: TTR for that ocean lane is 5 weeks; your TTS on current inventory is 3 weeks.
segments.tr: Anda membuka daftar risiko dan menemukan angka jujurnya: TTR untuk jalur laut tersebut adalah 5 minggu; TTS Anda atas persediaan saat ini adalah 3 minggu.

segments.src: Two weeks exposed.
segments.tr: Dua minggu tanpa perlindungan.

segments.src: The options each carry a price you can actually compute — air freight a partial order at maybe $4–6 per kilogram versus roughly $0.30 by ocean, hold four extra weeks of safety stock at a carrying cost of 20–25% of inventory value per year, or qualify a second supplier at a few months of engineering time.
segments.tr: Setiap opsi memiliki harga yang benar-benar bisa dihitung: mengirim sebagian pesanan dengan udara seharga sekitar $4–6 per kilogram dibandingkan sekitar $0,30 lewat laut, menahan persediaan pengaman tambahan empat minggu dengan biaya penyimpanan 20–25% dari nilai persediaan per tahun, atau mengkualifikasi pemasok kedua dengan beberapa bulan waktu rekayasa.

segments.src: None of those choices is obvious.
segments.tr: Tidak ada pilihan yang langsung jelas.

segments.src: But once you've written down the perfect order rate, the fine schedule, TTR versus TTS, and the carrying cost, you're making a business decision instead of a guess.
segments.tr: Namun setelah Anda menuliskan tingkat pesanan sempurna, jadwal denda, TTR versus TTS, dan biaya penyimpanan, Anda sedang membuat keputusan bisnis, bukan menebak.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Rekap Tiga Baris

segments.src: 1. Component metrics lie; end-to-end metrics like perfect order rate and cash-to-cash tell the truth, because errors multiply rather than average.
segments.tr: 1. Metrik komponen menyesatkan; metrik ujung-ke-ujung seperti tingkat pesanan sempurna dan kas-ke-kas mengatakan yang sebenarnya, karena kesalahan saling mengalikan, bukan saling merata-ratakan.

segments.src: 2. SCOR provides shared language and forces the trade-off — reliability, responsiveness, agility, cost, and assets cannot all be maximized at once.
segments.tr: 2. SCOR menyediakan bahasa bersama dan memaksa adanya trade-off: keandalan, daya tanggap, kegesitan, biaya, dan aset tidak bisa dimaksimalkan sekaligus.

segments.src: 3. Manage risk by comparing time-to-recover with time-to-survive rather than guessing probabilities, and treat emissions per ton-mile as a real KPI alongside cost.
segments.tr: 3. Kelola risiko dengan membandingkan time-to-recover dengan time-to-survive alih-alih menebak probabilitas, dan perlakukan emisi per ton-mil sebagai KPI nyata di samping biaya.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri

segments.src: **1.** A shipper hits 99% on-time, 98% complete, 99% damage-free, and 100% correct documentation.
segments.tr: **1.** Sebuah pengirim mencapai 99% tepat waktu, 98% lengkap, 99% bebas kerusakan, dan 100% dokumentasi benar.

segments.src: What is the perfect order rate?
segments.tr: Berapa tingkat pesanan sempurnanya?
A) 99,0%  B) 98,0%  C) sekitar 96,0%  D) 100%

segments.src: (O/X)** A disruption with very low probability can safely be ignored in a risk register.
segments.tr: (O/X)** Peristiwa gangguan dengan probabilitas sangat rendah dapat diabaikan dengan aman dalam daftar risiko.

segments.src: **3.** Cash-to-cash cycle time is calculated as:
segments.tr: **3.** Waktu siklus kas-ke-kas dihitung sebagai:

segments.src: A) inventory days + receivable days − payable days
segments.tr: A) hari persediaan + hari piutang − hari utang

segments.src: B) receivable days + payable days − inventory days
segments.tr: B) hari piutang + hari utang − hari persediaan

segments.src: C) order cycle time + transit time
segments.tr: C) waktu siklus pesanan + waktu transit

segments.src: D) revenue ÷ average inventory
segments.tr: D) pendapatan ÷ rata-rata persediaan

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini

segments.src: - **Perfect Order Rate** — Share of orders delivered on time, complete, undamaged, and correctly documented; the four rates multiply.
segments.tr: - **Perfect Order Rate**: Persentase pesanan yang dikirim tepat waktu, lengkap, tidak rusak, dan didokumentasikan dengan benar; keempat tingkat tersebut saling dikalikan.

segments.src: - **SCOR** — The Supply Chain Operations Reference model, an ASCM-maintained standard for describing supply chain processes and scoring their performance.
segments.tr: - **SCOR**: The Supply Chain Operations Reference model, standar yang dikelola ASCM untuk mendeskripsikan proses rantai pasokan dan menilai kinerjanya.

segments.src: - **Cash-to-Cash Cycle Time** — Days of working capital tied up between paying suppliers and collecting from customers.
segments.tr: - **Cash-to-Cash Cycle Time**: Jumlah hari modal kerja yang terikat antara membayar pemasok dan menagih pelanggan.

segments.src: - **TTR / TTS** — Time to Recover from a disrupted node versus Time to Survive on existing inventory; exposure exists when TTR is longer than TTS.
segments.tr: - **TTR / TTS**: Time to Recover dari simpul yang terganggu dibandingkan Time to Survive atas persediaan yang ada; paparan risiko ada ketika TTR lebih lama daripada TTS.

segments.src: - **Scope 3 Emissions** — Indirect emissions from purchased goods and outsourced transportation, typically the largest share of a shipper's carbon footprint.
segments.tr: - **Scope 3 Emissions**: Emisi tidak langsung dari barang yang dibeli dan transportasi yang dialihdayakan, biasanya porsi terbesar dari jejak karbon pengirim.

segments.src: *Answers: 1 — C.
segments.tr: *Jawaban: 1 — C.

segments.src: 0.99 x 0.98 x 0.99 x 1.00 = 0.960, about 96%; four strong scores still leave four bad orders per hundred.
segments.tr: 0,99 x 0,98 x 0,99 x 1,00 = 0,960, sekitar 96%; empat skor yang kuat tetap menyisakan empat pesanan bermasalah per seratus.

segments.src: Rank by impact as well as likelihood; low-probability, high-impact events are exactly the ones that require a survival plan, since probability estimates for rare events are unreliable.
segments.tr: Urutkan berdasarkan dampak sekaligus kemungkinan; peristiwa berprobabilitas rendah namun berdampak tinggi justru yang memerlukan rencana bertahan, karena estimasi probabilitas untuk peristiwa langka tidak dapat diandalkan.

segments.src: Inventory days plus receivable days minus payable days; paying suppliers later and collecting sooner shortens the cycle.*
segments.tr: Hari persediaan ditambah hari piutang dikurangi hari utang; membayar pemasok lebih lambat dan menagih lebih cepat memperpendek siklus.*

ja.title: [物流101 #14] 98%の罠：「ほぼ定時」がなぜ実際のコストになるのか

segments.src: > A supply chain you can't measure is one you can't defend — this lesson covers the KPIs that matter, the SCOR framework that organizes them, how to price risk before it hits, and why emissions are becoming a logistics metric too.
segments.tr: > 測定できないサプライチェーンは、守ることもできません。今回のレッスンでは、重要なKPI、それらを整理するSCORフレームワーク、リスクが顕在化する前の価格付け、そして排出量も物流の指標になりつつある理由を扱います。

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 今日のコンセプト

segments.src: Every warehouse manager will tell you things are "running fine."
segments.tr: どの倉庫マネージャーに聞いても、「順調です」と答えるでしょう。

segments.src: The job of performance measurement is to replace that sentence with a number.
segments.tr: パフォーマンス測定の役割は、その一文を数字に置き換えることです。

segments.src: **Start with KPIs — but the right ones.** The single most useful logistics metric is the **perfect order rate**: the share of orders delivered on time, complete, undamaged, and with correct paperwork.
segments.tr: **まずKPIから——ただし、正しいKPIを選ぶことが重要です。** 物流で最も有用な指標は**完全注文率（Perfect Order Rate）**です：定時に、欠品なく、破損なく、書類も正しく揃って配送された注文の割合です。

segments.src: It's brutal because it multiplies:
segments.tr: これは掛け算で効いてくるため、非常に厳しい指標です：

segments.src: Perfect order rate = on-time % x complete % x damage-free % x correct-docs %
segments.tr: Perfect order rate = on-time % x complete % x damage-free % x correct-docs %

segments.src: Four "excellent" 98% scores produce a 92% perfect order rate.
segments.tr: 「優秀」な98%が4つあっても、完全注文率は92%にしかなりません。

segments.src: Eight orders in every hundred go wrong somewhere.
segments.tr: 100件の注文のうち8件は、どこかで問題が起きています。

segments.src: That gap between component metrics and end-to-end metrics is where most supply chain complaints live.
segments.tr: この、個別指標とエンドツーエンド指標の差こそ、サプライチェーンへの苦情の大半が生まれる場所です。

segments.src: Other core measures:
segments.tr: その他の主要指標：

segments.src: - **Order fulfillment cycle time** — order placed to customer receipt.
segments.tr: - **注文充足サイクルタイム** —— 注文の確定から顧客の受領までの時間。

segments.src: - **Cash-to-cash cycle time** — days between paying your supplier and getting paid by your customer: `inventory days + receivable days - payable days`.
segments.tr: - **キャッシュ・トゥ・キャッシュ・サイクルタイム** —— 仕入先に支払ってから顧客から入金を受けるまでの日数：`inventory days + receivable days - payable days`。

segments.src: - **Inventory turns** and **days of supply** — how hard your working capital is working.
segments.tr: - **在庫回転率**と**供給日数** —— 運転資本がどれだけ効率的に働いているかを示す指標。

segments.src: - **Cost to serve** — total logistics cost per order, per unit, or per customer.
segments.tr: - **サービス提供コスト（Cost to Serve）** —— 注文単位、数量単位、または顧客単位での物流コスト総額。

segments.src: **SCOR gives these a home.** The Supply Chain Operations Reference model, maintained by ASCM, is the industry's standard vocabulary.
segments.tr: **SCORはこれらの指標に居場所を与えます。** ASCMが管理するSupply Chain Operations Reference（SCOR）モデルは、業界標準の共通語彙です。

segments.src: Classic SCOR organizes a supply chain into six process areas — Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, Return, and Enable — and scores them on five attributes: reliability, responsiveness, agility, cost, and asset management efficiency.
segments.tr: 従来のSCORでは、サプライチェーンを6つのプロセス領域——Plan（計画）、Source（調達）、Make（生産）、Deliver（配送）、Return（返品）、Enable（支援）——に分け、信頼性、応答性、アジリティ、コスト、資産管理効率の5つの属性で評価します。

segments.src: The current digital revision (SCOR DS) renames and regroups those processes and folds in environmental and social measures alongside the economic ones.
segments.tr: 現在のデジタル版（SCOR DS）では、これらのプロセスの名称や分類を変更し、経済指標と並んで環境・社会指標も組み込んでいます。

segments.src: The details shift between versions; the useful idea doesn't.
segments.tr: バージョンによって細部は変わりますが、有用な考え方は変わりません。

segments.src: SCOR forces you to say *which attribute* you're optimizing, because you cannot maximize all five.
segments.tr: SCORでは、5つすべてを最大化することはできないため、**どの属性を最適化しようとしているのか**を明示せざるを得なくなります。

segments.src: Faster response usually costs more.
segments.tr: 応答性を高めるとコストが上がるのが普通です。

segments.src: Lower cost usually means less agility.
segments.tr: コストを下げると、通常はアジリティが犠牲になります。

segments.src: Pick, then measure.
segments.tr: まず選び、そのうえで測定しましょう。

segments.src: **Risk management is measurement pointed at the future.** The standard move is a risk register: list what could break, score each item on **likelihood** and **impact**, and multiply to rank.
segments.tr: **リスク管理は、未来に向けた測定です。** 標準的な方法はリスク登録簿（リスクレジスター）です：何が壊れうるかを列挙し、各項目を**発生可能性（likelihood）**と**影響度（impact）**で採点し、掛け合わせて順位付けします。

segments.src: But logistics risk has a twist — the worst events are the low-probability ones, so probability estimates are close to worthless.
segments.tr: ただし物流リスクには特有の難しさがあります。最悪の事態は発生確率が低いものが多いため、確率の見積もりはほとんど役に立たないのです。

segments.src: A more practical pair of questions, popularized by MIT's David Simchi-Levi:
segments.tr: より実践的な2つの問いがあり、MITのDavid Simchi-Leviによって広く知られるようになりました：

segments.src: - **Time to Recover (TTR):** if this node goes dark, how long until supply is restored?
segments.tr: - **復旧時間（TTR, Time to Recover）：** この拠点が停止した場合、供給が回復するまでどれくらいかかるか？

segments.src: - **Time to Survive (TTS):** how long can we keep serving customers on inventory and alternatives?
segments.tr: - **生存時間（TTS, Time to Survive）：** 在庫と代替手段だけで、顧客への供給をどれくらい続けられるか？

segments.src: If TTR exceeds TTS, you have a real exposure, whatever the probability.
segments.tr: TTRがTTSを上回る場合、発生確率にかかわらず、現実的なリスクがあります。

segments.src: The fixes are familiar: dual sourcing, safety stock at the right node, qualified backup carriers, postponement (finish the product late, closer to demand), and visibility into tier-2 and tier-3 suppliers — because the plant that shuts down is usually one your buyer has never heard of.
segments.tr: 対策は馴染みのあるものばかりです：デュアルソーシング、適切な拠点への安全在庫の配置、代替輸送業者の認定、後工程化（延期：需要に近い段階で製品を仕上げること）、そしてTier 2・Tier 3の仕入先の可視化。停止するのは、多くの場合、バイヤーが名前さえ聞いたことのない工場だからです。

segments.src: **Sustainability is now a logistics KPI, not a press release.** Transportation and purchased goods sit in **Scope 3** emissions, which for most retailers and manufacturers dwarf their own facilities and fleet.
segments.tr: **サステナビリティは、もはやプレスリリースではなく物流KPIです。** 輸送と購入品はスコープ3排出に含まれ、多くの小売業者やメーカーでは、これが自社拠点や車両からの排出をはるかに上回ります。

segments.src: The operational levers are the same ones that cut cost: raise trailer load factor, cut **empty miles**, shift long hauls from truck to intermodal rail, right-size packaging, consolidate LTL shipments into full truckloads.
segments.tr: 運用上のレバーは、コストを削減するものと同じです：トレーラーの積載率を上げ、**空車走行距離**を減らし、長距離輸送をトラックから複合一貫輸送（鉄道）へ移し、梱包サイズを適正化し、LTL（小口貨物）出荷を満載（FTL）にまとめること。

segments.src: Emissions per ton-mile is the metric; the EPA's SmartWay program is the common US benchmark for carrier performance.
segments.tr: 指標は「トンマイルあたりの排出量」で、EPAのSmartWayプログラムは、輸送業者の性能に関する米国の一般的なベンチマークです。

segments.tr: ## 日常生活の例

segments.src: Two weeks exposed.
segments.tr: 2週間分が無防備になります。

segments.tr: 選択肢にはそれぞれ、実際に計算可能なコストがあります。一部注文を航空輸送すると1kgあたり$4–6程度、海上輸送なら約$0.30。安全在庫を4週間分余分に持つと、在庫評価額の年間20–25%の在庫維持費がかかります。第二の仕入先を認定するには、数か月のエンジニアリング工数が必要です。

segments.src: None of those choices is obvious.
segments.tr: どの選択も自明ではありません。

segments.src: But once you've written down the perfect order rate, the fine schedule, TTR versus TTS, and the carrying cost, you're making a business decision instead of a guess.
segments.tr: しかし、完全注文率、罰金のスケジュール、TTRとTTS、在庫維持費を書き出してしまえば、もはや推測ではなく経営判断を下していることになります。

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## 3行でまとめ

segments.src: 1. Component metrics lie; end-to-end metrics like perfect order rate and cash-to-cash tell the truth, because errors multiply rather than average.

segments.src: 3. Manage risk by comparing time-to-recover with time-to-survive rather than guessing probabilities, and treat emissions per ton-mile as a real KPI alongside cost.

de.title: [Logistics 101 #14] Die 98-%-Falle: Warum „fast pünktlich“ Sie echtes Geld kostet

segments.src: > A supply chain you can't measure is one you can't defend — this lesson covers the KPIs that matter, the SCOR framework that organizes them, how to price risk before it hits, and why emissions are becoming a logistics metric too.
segments.tr: > Eine Lieferkette, die Sie nicht messen können, können Sie auch nicht verteidigen. Diese Lektion behandelt die wichtigsten KPIs, das SCOR-Framework, das sie ordnet, wie Sie Risiken vor ihrem Eintreten bepreisen und warum auch Emissionen zu einer Logistikkennzahl werden.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Heutiges Konzept

segments.src: Every warehouse manager will tell you things are "running fine."
segments.tr: Jeder Lagerleiter wird Ihnen sagen, dass alles „gut läuft“.

segments.src: The job of performance measurement is to replace that sentence with a number.
segments.tr: Die Aufgabe der Leistungsmessung ist es, diesen Satz durch eine Zahl zu ersetzen.

segments.src: **Start with KPIs — but the right ones.** The single most useful logistics metric is the **perfect order rate**: the share of orders delivered on time, complete, undamaged, and with correct paperwork.
segments.tr: **Beginnen Sie mit KPIs, aber mit den richtigen.** Die nützlichste einzelne Logistikkennzahl ist die **Perfect-Order-Rate**: der Anteil der Aufträge, die pünktlich, vollständig, unbeschädigt und mit korrekten Begleitdokumenten geliefert werden.

segments.src: It's brutal because it multiplies:
segments.tr: Sie ist gnadenlos, denn sie multipliziert sich:

segments.src: Perfect order rate = on-time % x complete % x damage-free % x correct-docs %
segments.tr: Perfect order rate = on-time % x complete % x damage-free % x correct-docs %

segments.src: Four "excellent" 98% scores produce a 92% perfect order rate.
segments.tr: Vier „ausgezeichnete“ Werte von 98 % ergeben eine Perfect-Order-Rate von 92 %.

segments.src: Eight orders in every hundred go wrong somewhere.
segments.tr: Acht von hundert Aufträgen gehen irgendwo schief.

segments.src: That gap between component metrics and end-to-end metrics is where most supply chain complaints live.
segments.tr: Diese Lücke zwischen Einzelkennzahlen und End-to-End-Kennzahlen ist der Ort, an dem die meisten Beschwerden über Lieferketten entstehen.

segments.src: Other core measures:
segments.tr: Weitere Kernkennzahlen:

segments.src: - **Order fulfillment cycle time** — order placed to customer receipt.
segments.tr: - **Auftragsdurchlaufzeit** — von der Bestellung bis zum Wareneingang beim Kunden.

segments.src: - **Cash-to-cash cycle time** — days between paying your supplier and getting paid by your customer: `inventory days + receivable days - payable days`.
segments.tr: - **Cash-to-Cash-Zyklus** — Tage zwischen der Zahlung an den Lieferanten und dem Zahlungseingang vom Kunden: `inventory days + receivable days - payable days`.

segments.src: - **Inventory turns** and **days of supply** — how hard your working capital is working.
segments.tr: - **Lagerumschlag** und **Reichweite in Tagen** — wie hart Ihr Umlaufvermögen arbeitet.

segments.src: - **Cost to serve** — total logistics cost per order, per unit, or per customer.
segments.tr: - **Cost to Serve** — gesamte Logistikkosten pro Auftrag, pro Stück oder pro Kunde.

segments.src: **SCOR gives these a home.** The Supply Chain Operations Reference model, maintained by ASCM, is the industry's standard vocabulary.
segments.tr: **SCOR bietet dafür einen Rahmen.** Das Supply Chain Operations Reference-Modell, gepflegt von der ASCM, ist das branchenübliche Standardvokabular.

segments.src: Classic SCOR organizes a supply chain into six process areas — Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, Return, and Enable — and scores them on five attributes: reliability, responsiveness, agility, cost, and asset management efficiency.
segments.tr: Das klassische SCOR gliedert eine Lieferkette in sechs Prozessbereiche (Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, Return und Enable) und bewertet sie anhand von fünf Attributen: Zuverlässigkeit, Reaktionsfähigkeit, Agilität, Kosten und Effizienz des Vermögenseinsatzes.

segments.src: The current digital revision (SCOR DS) renames and regroups those processes and folds in environmental and social measures alongside the economic ones.
segments.tr: Die aktuelle digitale Revision (SCOR DS) benennt diese Prozesse um, gruppiert sie neu und ergänzt ökologische und soziale Kennzahlen neben den wirtschaftlichen.

segments.src: The details shift between versions; the useful idea doesn't.
segments.tr: Die Details verschieben sich zwischen den Versionen, die nützliche Idee bleibt jedoch dieselbe.

segments.src: SCOR forces you to say *which attribute* you're optimizing, because you cannot maximize all five.
segments.tr: SCOR zwingt Sie zu sagen, *welches Attribut* Sie optimieren, denn Sie können nicht alle fünf maximieren.

segments.src: Faster response usually costs more.
segments.tr: Schnellere Reaktion kostet meist mehr.

segments.src: Lower cost usually means less agility.
segments.tr: Niedrigere Kosten bedeuten meist weniger Agilität.

segments.src: Pick, then measure.
segments.tr: Wählen Sie, dann messen Sie.

segments.src: **Risk management is measurement pointed at the future.** The standard move is a risk register: list what could break, score each item on **likelihood** and **impact**, and multiply to rank.
segments.tr: **Risikomanagement ist Messung, auf die Zukunft gerichtet.** Der Standardschritt ist ein Risikoregister: Listen Sie auf, was ausfallen könnte, bewerten Sie jeden Punkt nach **Eintrittswahrscheinlichkeit** und **Auswirkung** und multiplizieren Sie, um zu priorisieren.

segments.src: But logistics risk has a twist — the worst events are the low-probability ones, so probability estimates are close to worthless.
segments.tr: Logistische Risiken haben jedoch eine Besonderheit: Die schlimmsten Ereignisse sind die mit geringer Wahrscheinlichkeit, daher sind Wahrscheinlichkeitsschätzungen nahezu wertlos.

segments.src: A more practical pair of questions, popularized by MIT's David Simchi-Levi:
segments.tr: Ein praktischeres Fragenpaar, popularisiert von David Simchi-Levi vom MIT:

segments.src: - **Time to Recover (TTR):** if this node goes dark, how long until supply is restored?
segments.tr: - **Wiederherstellungszeit (Time to Recover, TTR):** Wenn dieser Knoten ausfällt, wie lange dauert es, bis die Versorgung wiederhergestellt ist?

segments.src: - **Time to Survive (TTS):** how long can we keep serving customers on inventory and alternatives?
segments.tr: - **Überlebenszeit (Time to Survive, TTS):** Wie lange können wir Kunden mit Lagerbeständen und Alternativen weiter beliefern?

segments.src: If TTR exceeds TTS, you have a real exposure, whatever the probability.
segments.tr: Wenn TTR größer ist als TTS, haben Sie ein echtes Risiko, unabhängig von der Wahrscheinlichkeit.

segments.src: The fixes are familiar: dual sourcing, safety stock at the right node, qualified backup carriers, postponement (finish the product late, closer to demand), and visibility into tier-2 and tier-3 suppliers — because the plant that shuts down is usually one your buyer has never heard of.
segments.tr: Die Gegenmaßnahmen sind bekannt: Dual Sourcing, Sicherheitsbestand am richtigen Knoten, qualifizierte Ersatzspediteure, Postponement (das Produkt später fertigstellen, näher an der Nachfrage) und Transparenz bei Lieferanten der Stufen zwei und drei, denn das Werk, das stillsteht, ist meist eines, von dem Ihr Einkäufer nie gehört hat.

segments.src: **Sustainability is now a logistics KPI, not a press release.** Transportation and purchased goods sit in **Scope 3** emissions, which for most retailers and manufacturers dwarf their own facilities and fleet.
segments.tr: **Nachhaltigkeit ist heute eine Logistikkennzahl, keine Pressemitteilung.** Transport und eingekaufte Waren fallen unter die **Scope-3**-Emissionen, die bei den meisten Händlern und Herstellern die eigenen Standorte und den eigenen Fuhrpark weit übertreffen.

segments.src: The operational levers are the same ones that cut cost: raise trailer load factor, cut **empty miles**, shift long hauls from truck to intermodal rail, right-size packaging, consolidate LTL shipments into full truckloads.
segments.tr: Die operativen Hebel sind dieselben, die Kosten senken: den Auslastungsgrad der Trailer erhöhen, **Leerfahrten** reduzieren, lange Strecken von der Straße auf die intermodale Schiene verlagern, die Verpackung passend dimensionieren und LTL-Sendungen zu vollen Ladungen (FTL) bündeln.

segments.src: Emissions per ton-mile is the metric; the EPA's SmartWay program is the common US benchmark for carrier performance.
segments.tr: Emissionen pro Tonnenkilometer sind die Kennzahl; das SmartWay-Programm der US-Umweltbehörde EPA ist der gängige US-Maßstab für die Leistung von Frachtführern.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Im Alltag

segments.src: Say you run a Columbus, Ohio distributor selling houseware to a big-box retailer.
segments.tr: Angenommen, Sie betreiben einen Großhändler in Columbus, Ohio, der Haushaltswaren an eine große Handelskette verkauft.

segments.src: Your goods move from a supplier in Vietnam, through the Port of Long Beach, by rail to Chicago, then by truck to your DC.
segments.tr: Ihre Ware kommt von einem Lieferanten in Vietnam, läuft über den Hafen von Long Beach, per Bahn nach Chicago und dann per Lkw in Ihr Distributionszentrum.

segments.src: Your internal dashboard looks great: 97% on-time from the DC, 99% pick accuracy.
segments.tr: Ihr internes Dashboard sieht großartig aus: 97 % pünktlich ab dem Distributionszentrum, 99 % Kommissioniergenauigkeit.

segments.src: Then your retail customer's scorecard arrives.
segments.tr: Dann kommt die Scorecard Ihres Handelskunden.

segments.src: Large chains run **OTIF (on-time, in-full)** programs and charge suppliers for misses — Walmart's has assessed fees of roughly 3% of the value of noncompliant goods.
segments.tr: Große Ketten betreiben **OTIF-Programme (on-time, in-full)** und berechnen Lieferanten Strafen bei Abweichungen. Das Programm von Walmart hat Gebühren von etwa 3 % des Werts nicht konformer Ware verhängt.

segments.src: On $8 million of annual shipments to that account, a 10% miss rate is about $24,000 in fines, plus expedited freight to chase the shortfalls, plus a worse position in next year's negotiation.
segments.tr: Bei 8 Mio. $ Jahresumsatz mit diesem Konto kosten eine Abweichungsquote von 10 % etwa 24.000 $ an Strafen, dazu Expressfracht, um die Fehlmengen nachzuliefern, und eine schlechtere Position bei den Verhandlungen im nächsten Jahr.

segments.src: Then the port slows down for three weeks.
segments.tr: Dann verlangsamt sich der Hafen für drei Wochen.

segments.src: You dig into your risk register and find the honest numbers: TTR for that ocean lane is 5 weeks; your TTS on current inventory is 3 weeks.
segments.tr: Sie sehen in Ihr Risikoregister und finden die ehrlichen Zahlen: TTR für diese Seeroute beträgt 5 Wochen, Ihre TTS auf dem aktuellen Bestand beträgt 3 Wochen.

segments.src: Two weeks exposed.
segments.tr: Zwei Wochen ungeschützt.

segments.src: The options each carry a price you can actually compute — air freight a partial order at maybe $4–6 per kilogram versus roughly $0.30 by ocean, hold four extra weeks of safety stock at a carrying cost of 20–25% of inventory value per year, or qualify a second supplier at a few months of engineering time.
segments.tr: Jede Option hat einen Preis, den Sie tatsächlich berechnen können: Teilmengen per Luftfracht für vielleicht 4–6 $ pro Kilogramm statt etwa 0.30 $ per See, vier zusätzliche Wochen Sicherheitsbestand bei Lagerhaltungskosten von 20–25 % des Lagerwerts pro Jahr oder die Qualifizierung eines zweiten Lieferanten mit einigen Monaten Entwicklungsaufwand.

segments.src: None of those choices is obvious.
segments.tr: Keine dieser Entscheidungen ist offensichtlich.

segments.src: But once you've written down the perfect order rate, the fine schedule, TTR versus TTS, and the carrying cost, you're making a business decision instead of a guess.
segments.tr: Doch wenn Sie die Perfect-Order-Rate, die Strafenstaffel, TTR gegenüber TTS und die Lagerhaltungskosten einmal festgehalten haben, treffen Sie eine geschäftliche Entscheidung statt einer Vermutung.

segments.tr: ## Zusammenfassung in drei Zeilen

segments.src: 3. Manage risk by comparing time-to-recover with time-to-survive rather than guessing probabilities, and treat emissions per ton-mile as a real KPI alongside cost.
segments.tr: 3. Steuern Sie Risiken, indem Sie Wiederherstellungszeit mit Überlebenszeit vergleichen, statt Wahrscheinlichkeiten zu raten, und behandeln Sie Emissionen pro Tonnenkilometer als echte Kennzahl neben den Kosten.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Every warehouse manager will tell you things are "running fine."

segments.src: The job of performance measurement is to replace that sentence with a number.
segments.tr: Nhiệm vụ của đo lường hiệu suất là thay câu nói đó bằng một con số.

segments.src: **Start with KPIs — but the right ones.** The single most useful logistics metric is the **perfect order rate**: the share of orders delivered on time, complete, undamaged, and with correct paperwork.
segments.tr: **Bắt đầu từ KPI — nhưng phải là những KPI đúng.** Chỉ số logistics hữu ích nhất là **tỷ lệ đơn hàng hoàn hảo**: tỷ lệ đơn hàng được giao đúng hạn, đủ số lượng, không hư hỏng và có đầy đủ chứng từ chính xác.

segments.src: It's brutal because it multiplies:
segments.tr: Chỉ số này rất khắt khe vì nó được tính theo phép nhân:

segments.src: Perfect order rate = on-time % x complete % x damage-free % x correct-docs %
segments.tr: Perfect order rate = on-time % x complete % x damage-free % x correct-docs %

segments.src: Four "excellent" 98% scores produce a 92% perfect order rate.
segments.tr: Bốn chỉ số "xuất sắc" 98% cho ra tỷ lệ đơn hàng hoàn hảo chỉ 92%.

segments.src: Eight orders in every hundred go wrong somewhere.
segments.tr: Cứ mỗi 100 đơn hàng thì có 8 đơn gặp sự cố ở một khâu nào đó.

segments.src: That gap between component metrics and end-to-end metrics is where most supply chain complaints live.
segments.tr: Khoảng cách giữa chỉ số thành phần và chỉ số đầu-cuối chính là nơi phần lớn các khiếu nại về chuỗi cung ứng phát sinh.

segments.src: Other core measures:
segments.tr: Các chỉ số cốt lõi khác:

segments.src: - **Order fulfillment cycle time** — order placed to customer receipt.
segments.tr: - **Thời gian chu kỳ thực hiện đơn hàng** — từ lúc đặt hàng đến lúc khách hàng nhận được hàng.

segments.src: - **Cash-to-cash cycle time** — days between paying your supplier and getting paid by your customer: `inventory days + receivable days - payable days`.
segments.tr: - **Thời gian chu kỳ tiền-về-tiền (cash-to-cash)** — số ngày từ lúc bạn trả tiền cho nhà cung cấp đến lúc bạn nhận được tiền từ khách hàng: `số ngày tồn kho + số ngày phải thu - số ngày phải trả`.

segments.src: - **Inventory turns** and **days of supply** — how hard your working capital is working.
segments.tr: - **Vòng quay hàng tồn kho** và **số ngày tồn kho đáp ứng** — vốn lưu động của bạn đang hoạt động hiệu quả đến mức nào.

segments.src: - **Cost to serve** — total logistics cost per order, per unit, or per customer.
segments.tr: - **Chi phí phục vụ** — tổng chi phí logistics trên mỗi đơn hàng, mỗi đơn vị sản phẩm hoặc mỗi khách hàng.

segments.src: **SCOR gives these a home.** The Supply Chain Operations Reference model, maintained by ASCM, is the industry's standard vocabulary.
segments.tr: **SCOR cung cấp một vị trí cho các chỉ số này.** Mô hình Supply Chain Operations Reference, do ASCM duy trì, là bộ từ vựng tiêu chuẩn của ngành.

segments.src: Classic SCOR organizes a supply chain into six process areas — Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, Return, and Enable — and scores them on five attributes: reliability, responsiveness, agility, cost, and asset management efficiency.
segments.tr: SCOR cổ điển sắp xếp chuỗi cung ứng thành sáu nhóm quy trình — Plan (Hoạch định), Source (Mua hàng), Make (Sản xuất), Deliver (Giao hàng), Return (Hoàn trả) và Enable (Hỗ trợ) — và đánh giá chúng theo năm thuộc tính: độ tin cậy, khả năng đáp ứng, tính linh hoạt, chi phí và hiệu quả sử dụng tài sản.

segments.src: The current digital revision (SCOR DS) renames and regroups those processes and folds in environmental and social measures alongside the economic ones.
segments.tr: Phiên bản số hiện tại (SCOR DS) đổi tên và nhóm lại các quy trình đó, đồng thời đưa các chỉ số môi trường và xã hội vào cùng với các chỉ số kinh tế.

segments.src: The details shift between versions; the useful idea doesn't.
segments.tr: Chi tiết có thể thay đổi giữa các phiên bản, nhưng ý tưởng hữu ích thì không đổi.

segments.src: SCOR forces you to say *which attribute* you're optimizing, because you cannot maximize all five.
segments.tr: SCOR buộc bạn phải nói rõ *thuộc tính nào* đang được tối ưu, vì bạn không thể tối đa hóa cả năm thuộc tính.

segments.src: Faster response usually costs more.
segments.tr: Phản ứng nhanh hơn thường tốn kém hơn.

segments.src: Lower cost usually means less agility.
segments.tr: Chi phí thấp hơn thường đồng nghĩa với tính linh hoạt kém hơn.

segments.src: Pick, then measure.
segments.tr: Hãy chọn trước, rồi đo lường sau.

segments.src: **Risk management is measurement pointed at the future.** The standard move is a risk register: list what could break, score each item on **likelihood** and **impact**, and multiply to rank.
segments.tr: **Quản trị rủi ro chính là đo lường hướng về tương lai.** Cách làm tiêu chuẩn là lập sổ đăng ký rủi ro: liệt kê những điều có thể hỏng, chấm điểm từng mục theo **khả năng xảy ra** và **mức tác động**, rồi nhân hai điểm để xếp hạng.

segments.src: But logistics risk has a twist — the worst events are the low-probability ones, so probability estimates are close to worthless.
segments.tr: Nhưng rủi ro logistics có một điểm đặc biệt — các sự kiện nghiêm trọng nhất lại là những sự kiện có xác suất thấp, nên ước tính xác suất gần như vô nghĩa.

segments.src: A more practical pair of questions, popularized by MIT's David Simchi-Levi:
segments.tr: Một cặp câu hỏi thực tế hơn, được phổ biến bởi David Simchi-Levi thuộc MIT:

segments.src: - **Time to Recover (TTR):** if this node goes dark, how long until supply is restored?
segments.tr: - **Thời gian khôi phục (TTR):** nếu mắt xích này ngừng hoạt động, bao lâu nữa nguồn cung mới được khôi phục?

segments.src: - **Time to Survive (TTS):** how long can we keep serving customers on inventory and alternatives?
segments.tr: - **Thời gian sinh tồn (TTS):** chúng ta có thể tiếp tục phục vụ khách hàng bằng hàng tồn kho và các phương án thay thế trong bao lâu?

segments.src: If TTR exceeds TTS, you have a real exposure, whatever the probability.
segments.tr: Nếu TTR vượt quá TTS, bạn đang có một rủi ro thực sự, bất kể xác suất là bao nhiêu.

segments.src: The fixes are familiar: dual sourcing, safety stock at the right node, qualified backup carriers, postponement (finish the product late, closer to demand), and visibility into tier-2 and tier-3 suppliers — because the plant that shuts down is usually one your buyer has never heard of.
segments.tr: Các giải pháp đã quen thuộc: nguồn cung kép, tồn kho an toàn đặt đúng mắt xích, các nhà vận chuyển dự phòng đã đủ điều kiện, trì hoãn (postponement — hoàn thiện sản phẩm muộn hơn, gần với nhu cầu hơn), và khả năng nhìn thấy các nhà cung cấp tầng 2 và tầng 3 — vì nhà máy bị ngừng hoạt động thường là nhà máy mà bộ phận mua hàng của bạn chưa từng nghe đến.

segments.src: **Sustainability is now a logistics KPI, not a press release.** Transportation and purchased goods sit in **Scope 3** emissions, which for most retailers and manufacturers dwarf their own facilities and fleet.
segments.tr: **Tính bền vững giờ đây là một KPI logistics, không chỉ là thông cáo báo chí.** Vận tải và hàng hóa mua vào nằm trong phát thải **Scope 3**, vốn với đa số nhà bán lẻ và nhà sản xuất còn lớn hơn nhiều so với cơ sở và đội xe của chính họ.

segments.src: The operational levers are the same ones that cut cost: raise trailer load factor, cut **empty miles**, shift long hauls from truck to intermodal rail, right-size packaging, consolidate LTL shipments into full truckloads.
segments.tr: Các đòn bẩy vận hành giống với những đòn bẩy giúp cắt giảm chi phí: nâng hệ số tải của xe chở hàng, giảm **quãng đường chạy rỗng**, chuyển các tuyến đường dài từ xe tải sang đường sắt liên phương thức, tối ưu kích thước bao bì, gom các lô LTL thành chuyến xe tải đầy.

segments.src: Emissions per ton-mile is the metric; the EPA's SmartWay program is the common US benchmark for carrier performance.
segments.tr: Chỉ số phù hợp là phát thải trên mỗi tấn-dặm; chương trình SmartWay của EPA là tiêu chuẩn phổ biến ở Mỹ để đánh giá hiệu suất của các đơn vị vận tải.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Trong đời sống hằng ngày

segments.src: Say you run a Columbus, Ohio distributor selling houseware to a big-box retailer.
segments.tr: Giả sử bạn điều hành một nhà phân phối ở Columbus, Ohio, bán đồ gia dụng cho một chuỗi bán lẻ lớn.

segments.src: Your goods move from a supplier in Vietnam, through the Port of Long Beach, by rail to Chicago, then by truck to your DC.
segments.tr: Hàng hóa của bạn được chuyển từ nhà cung cấp ở Việt Nam, qua Cảng Long Beach, bằng đường sắt đến Chicago, rồi bằng xe tải đến trung tâm phân phối (DC) của bạn.

segments.src: Your internal dashboard looks great: 97% on-time from the DC, 99% pick accuracy.
segments.tr: Bảng điều khiển nội bộ của bạn trông rất ổn: 97% đúng hạn từ DC, 99% độ chính xác khi lấy hàng.

segments.src: Then your retail customer's scorecard arrives.
segments.tr: Rồi bảng điểm của khách hàng bán lẻ được gửi đến.

segments.src: Large chains run **OTIF (on-time, in-full)** programs and charge suppliers for misses — Walmart's has assessed fees of roughly 3% of the value of noncompliant goods.
segments.tr: Các chuỗi lớn vận hành chương trình **OTIF (đúng hạn, đủ hàng)** và phạt nhà cung cấp khi giao thiếu — chương trình của Walmart từng áp mức phạt khoảng 3% giá trị hàng không đạt yêu cầu.

segments.src: On $8 million of annual shipments to that account, a 10% miss rate is about $24,000 in fines, plus expedited freight to chase the shortfalls, plus a worse position in next year's negotiation.
segments.tr: Với 8 triệu USD hàng giao mỗi năm cho tài khoản đó, tỷ lệ giao thiếu 10% tương đương khoảng 24.000 USD tiền phạt, cộng thêm chi phí vận chuyển nhanh để bù phần thiếu, cộng thêm vị thế kém hơn trong đàm phán năm sau.

segments.src: Then the port slows down for three weeks.
segments.tr: Rồi cảng bị chậm trễ trong ba tuần.

segments.src: You dig into your risk register and find the honest numbers: TTR for that ocean lane is 5 weeks; your TTS on current inventory is 3 weeks.
segments.tr: Bạn xem lại sổ đăng ký rủi ro và thấy những con số thực: TTR của tuyến đường biển đó là 5 tuần; TTS của bạn với hàng tồn kho hiện có là 3 tuần.

segments.src: Two weeks exposed.
segments.tr: Hai tuần bị lộ rủi ro.

segments.src: The options each carry a price you can actually compute — air freight a partial order at maybe $4–6 per kilogram versus roughly $0.30 by ocean, hold four extra weeks of safety stock at a carrying cost of 20–25% of inventory value per year, or qualify a second supplier at a few months of engineering time.
segments.tr: Mỗi phương án đều có một chi phí bạn thực sự có thể tính được — vận chuyển hàng đường hàng không một phần đơn hàng với khoảng 4–6 USD mỗi kilogram, so với khoảng 0,30 USD bằng đường biển; giữ thêm bốn tuần tồn kho an toàn với chi phí lưu kho 20–25% giá trị hàng tồn kho mỗi năm; hoặc đánh giá đủ điều kiện một nhà cung cấp thứ hai trong vài tháng công sức kỹ thuật.

segments.src: None of those choices is obvious.
segments.tr: Không lựa chọn nào trong số này là hiển nhiên.

segments.src: But once you've written down the perfect order rate, the fine schedule, TTR versus TTS, and the carrying cost, you're making a business decision instead of a guess.
segments.tr: Nhưng khi bạn đã ghi lại tỷ lệ đơn hàng hoàn hảo, lịch phạt, TTR so với TTS và chi phí lưu kho, bạn đang đưa ra một quyết định kinh doanh chứ không phải phỏng đoán.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Tóm tắt trong ba dòng

segments.src: 1. Component metrics lie; end-to-end metrics like perfect order rate and cash-to-cash tell the truth, because errors multiply rather than average.
segments.tr: 1. Các chỉ số thành phần có thể gây hiểu lầm; các chỉ số đầu-cuối như tỷ lệ đơn hàng hoàn hảo và tiền-về-tiền mới cho thấy sự thật, vì các lỗi nhân lên thay vì trung bình hóa.

segments.src: 2. SCOR provides shared language and forces the trade-off — reliability, responsiveness, agility, cost, and assets cannot all be maximized at once.
segments.tr: 2. SCOR cung cấp ngôn ngữ chung và buộc phải đánh đổi — độ tin cậy, khả năng đáp ứng, tính linh hoạt, chi phí và tài sản không thể đồng thời được tối đa hóa.

segments.src: 3. Manage risk by comparing time-to-recover with time-to-survive rather than guessing probabilities, and treat emissions per ton-mile as a real KPI alongside cost.
segments.tr: 3. Quản trị rủi ro bằng cách so sánh thời gian khôi phục với thời gian sinh tồn thay vì đoán xác suất, và coi phát thải trên mỗi tấn-dặm là một KPI thực sự bên cạnh chi phí.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ Bài kiểm tra tự đánh giá

segments.src: **1.** A shipper hits 99% on-time, 98% complete, 99% damage-free, and 100% correct documentation.
segments.tr: **1.** Một chủ hàng đạt 99% đúng hạn, 98% đủ hàng, 99% không hư hỏng và 100% chứng từ chính xác.

segments.src: What is the perfect order rate?
segments.tr: Tỷ lệ đơn hàng hoàn hảo là bao nhiêu?
A) 99.0%  B) 98.0%  C) khoảng 96.0%  D) 100%

segments.src: (O/X)** A disruption with very low probability can safely be ignored in a risk register.
segments.tr: (O/X)** Một sự cố có xác suất rất thấp có thể được bỏ qua an toàn trong sổ đăng ký rủi ro.

segments.src: **3.** Cash-to-cash cycle time is calculated as:
segments.tr: **3.** Thời gian chu kỳ tiền-về-tiền được tính như sau:

segments.src: A) inventory days + receivable days − payable days
segments.tr: A) số ngày tồn kho + số ngày phải thu − số ngày phải trả

segments.src: B) receivable days + payable days − inventory days
segments.tr: B) số ngày phải thu + số ngày phải trả − số ngày tồn kho

segments.src: C) order cycle time + transit time
segments.tr: C) thời gian chu kỳ đặt hàng + thời gian vận chuyển

segments.src: D) revenue ÷ average inventory
segments.tr: D) doanh thu ÷ hàng tồn kho bình quân

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Thuật ngữ hôm nay

segments.src: - **Perfect Order Rate** — Share of orders delivered on time, complete, undamaged, and correctly documented; the four rates multiply.
segments.tr: - **Perfect Order Rate (Tỷ lệ đơn hàng hoàn hảo)** — Tỷ lệ đơn hàng được giao đúng hạn, đủ số lượng, không hư hỏng và có chứng từ chính xác; bốn tỷ lệ thành phần được nhân với nhau.

segments.src: - **SCOR** — The Supply Chain Operations Reference model, an ASCM-maintained standard for describing supply chain processes and scoring their performance.
segments.tr: - **SCOR** — Mô hình Supply Chain Operations Reference, một tiêu chuẩn do ASCM duy trì để mô tả các quy trình chuỗi cung ứng và đánh giá hiệu suất của chúng.

segments.src: - **Cash-to-Cash Cycle Time** — Days of working capital tied up between paying suppliers and collecting from customers.
segments.tr: - **Cash-to-Cash Cycle Time (Thời gian chu kỳ tiền-về-tiền)** — Số ngày vốn lưu động bị giữ lại giữa thời điểm trả tiền cho nhà cung cấp và thời điểm thu tiền từ khách hàng.

segments.src: - **TTR / TTS** — Time to Recover from a disrupted node versus Time to Survive on existing inventory; exposure exists when TTR is longer than TTS.
segments.tr: - **TTR / TTS** — Thời gian khôi phục sau khi một mắt xích bị gián đoạn so với thời gian sinh tồn bằng hàng tồn kho hiện có; rủi ro xuất hiện khi TTR dài hơn TTS.

segments.src: - **Scope 3 Emissions** — Indirect emissions from purchased goods and outsourced transportation, typically the largest share of a shipper's carbon footprint.
segments.tr: - **Scope 3 Emissions (Phát thải Scope 3)** — Phát thải gián tiếp từ hàng hóa mua vào và vận tải thuê ngoài, thường là phần lớn nhất trong dấu chân carbon của chủ hàng.

segments.src: *Answers: 1 — C.
segments.tr: *Đáp án: 1 — C.

segments.src: 0.99 x 0.98 x 0.99 x 1.00 = 0.960, about 96%; four strong scores still leave four bad orders per hundred.
segments.tr: 0,99 x 0,98 x 0,99 x 1,00 = 0,960, khoảng 96%; bốn chỉ số tốt vẫn để lại bốn đơn hàng lỗi trên mỗi 100 đơn.

segments.src: Rank by impact as well as likelihood; low-probability, high-impact events are exactly the ones that require a survival plan, since probability estimates for rare events are unreliable.
segments.tr: Hãy xếp hạng theo tác động cùng với khả năng xảy ra; các sự kiện có xác suất thấp nhưng tác động lớn chính là những sự kiện đòi hỏi một kế hoạch sinh tồn, vì ước tính xác suất cho các sự kiện hiếm là không đáng tin cậy.

segments.src: Inventory days plus receivable days minus payable days; paying suppliers later and collecting sooner shortens the cycle.*
segments.tr: Số ngày tồn kho cộng số ngày phải thu trừ số ngày phải trả; trả tiền nhà cung cấp muộn hơn và thu tiền sớm hơn sẽ rút ngắn chu kỳ.*
